 def compute_max_runoff_stats(
     max_series: pd.Series,
     use_normative_Cs: bool = True
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╡ ╤Е╨░╤А╨░╨║╤В╨╡╤А╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╨║╨╕ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤Б╤В╨╛╨║╨╛╨▓.
 
     ╨б╨Я 33-101-2003 ╨┐. 6.3.3: ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤Б╤В╨╛╨║╨╛╨▓ Cs тЙИ 2├ЧCv (╨┐╤А╨╕ Cv тЙд 0.5)
     ╨╕╨╗╨╕ Cs тЙИ 3├ЧCv (╨┐╤А╨╕ Cv > 0.5).
     """
     data = np.asarray(pd.Series(max_series).dropna(), dtype=float)
     if len(data) < 3:
         return {"mean": None, "Cv": None, "Cs": None, "n": len(data), "reliability_class": "╨Э╨╡╨┤╨╛╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛ ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╤Е"}
 
     n = len(data)
     mean = float(np.mean(data))
     std = float(np.std(data, ddof=1))
     Cv = std / mean if mean != 0 else 0.0
     Cs_emp = float(pd.Series(data).skew())
 
     if use_normative_Cs:
         Cs = 2.0 * Cv if Cv <= 0.5 else 3.0 * Cv
     else:
         Cs = Cs_emp
 
     epsilon = (Cv / np.sqrt(n)) * 100.0
 
     warnings = []
     reliability_class = "╨Э╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨░╤П"
     if n < 10:
         warnings.append(f"╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤В╨╕╤З╨╜╨╛: ╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨░ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░ {n} ╨╗╨╡╤В < 10")
         reliability_class = "╨Э╨╡╨╜╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨░╤П"
     elif n < 20:
         warnings.append(f"╨Ф╨╗╨╕╨╜╨░ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░ {n} ╨╗╨╡╤В < 20. ╨Ц╨╡╨╗╨░╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛ ╤Г╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡")
         reliability_class = "╨Я╨╛╨╜╨╕╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╜╨░╤П ╨╜╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М"
 
     if epsilon > 15:
         warnings.append(f"╬╡Q = {epsilon:.1f}% > 15%. ╨в╤А╨╡╨▒╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╤Г╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡")
         reliability_class = "╨Э╨╡╨╜╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨░╤П"
 
     return {
         "n": n,
         "mean": round(mean, 4),
         "std": round(std, 4),
         "Cv": round(Cv, 4),
         "Cs": round(Cs, 4),
         "Cs_empirical": round(Cs_emp, 4),
         "epsilon": round(epsilon, 2),
         "warnings": warnings,
         "reliability_class": reliability_class
     }
 
 
 def max_runoff_frequency_curve(
     max_series: pd.Series,
     P_values: Optional[List[float]] = None,
     use_normative_Cs: bool = True
 ) -> pd.DataFrame:
     """
     ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╨▓╨░╤П ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤Б╤В╨╛╨║╨╛╨▓ (╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜ III ╤В╨╕╨┐╨░).
 
     ╨б╨Я 33-101-2003 ╨┐. 8.1: ╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕:
     - ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨У╨в╨б I ╨║╨╗╨░╤Б╤Б╨░: 0.1%
     - ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨У╨в╨б II ╨║╨╗╨░╤Б╤Б╨░: 0.33%
     - ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨╝╨╛╤Б╤В╨╛╨▓: 1%, 5%
     - ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨▒╨╡╤А╨╡╨│╨╛╤Г╨║╤А╨╡╨┐╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П: 1%, 5%, 10%
 
     Parameters:
         max_series: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤Б╤В╨╛╨║╨╛╨▓
         P_values: ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨▓ % (╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╨╝╨╛╨╗╤З╨░╨╜╨╕╤О ╤Б╤В╨░╨╜╨┤╨░╤А╤В╨╜╤Л╨╡)
         use_normative_Cs: ╨╕╤Б╨┐╨╛╨╗╤М╨╖╨╛╨▓╨░╤В╤М ╨╜╨╛╤А╨╝╨░╤В╨╕╨▓╨╜╨╛╨╡ Cs
 
     Returns:
         DataFrame: P_%, Q_max, kp
     """
     if P_values is None:
         P_values = [0.1, 0.33, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0, 33.0, 50.0]
 
-    data = max_series.dropna().values
+    data = np.asarray(pd.Series(max_series).dropna(), dtype=float)
     if len(data) < 3:
         return pd.DataFrame({"P_%": P_values, "Q_max": [np.nan] * len(P_values), "kp": [np.nan] * len(P_values)})
 
     params = compute_max_runoff_stats(data, use_normative_Cs)
     mean = params["mean"]
     Cv = params["Cv"]
     Cs = params["Cs"]
 
     P_decimal = np.array(P_values) / 100.0
     from core.stats.frequency import pearson3_ppf
     quantiles = pearson3_ppf(P_decimal, mean, Cv, Cs)
 
     kp = quantiles / mean if mean != 0 else np.full_like(quantiles, np.nan)
 
     return pd.DataFrame({
         "P_%": P_values,

 def index_year_method(
     gauged_max_series: pd.Series,
     gauged_mean_annual: float,
     target_mean_annual: float,
     P_values: Optional[List[float]] = None
 ) -> pd.DataFrame:
     """
     ╨Ь╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╨╕╨╜╨┤╨╡╨║╤Б╨╜╤Л╤Е ╨│╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓ (╨б╨Я 33-101-2003 ╨┐. 8.2).
 
     ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨▒╨╡╨╖╤Б╤В╤А╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤А╨╡╨║:
     1. ╨Т╤Л╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╤П╨╡╨╝ K_i = Qmax_i / Qmean_i ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨║╨░╨╢╨┤╨╛╨│╨╛ ╨│╨╛╨┤╨░
     2. ╨б╤В╤А╨╛╨╕╨╝ ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╤Г╤О ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨┤╨╗╤П K
     3. Q_╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╨╛╨╡_p = K_p ├Ч Q╤Б╤А_╤Ж╨╡╨╗╨╡╨▓╨╛╨╣_╤А╨╡╨║╨╕
 
     Parameters:
         gauged_max_series: ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╤Л ╨╜╨░ ╤Б╤В╤А╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╜╨╛╨╝ ╤Г╤З╨░╤Б╤В╨║╨╡
         gauged_mean_annual: ╤Б╤А╨╡╨┤╨╜╨╡╨│╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤ ╨╜╨░ ╤Б╤В╤А╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╜╨╛╨╝ ╤Г╤З╨░╤Б╤В╨║╨╡
         target_mean_annual: ╤Б╤А╨╡╨┤╨╜╨╡╨│╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤ ╨╜╨░ ╤Ж╨╡╨╗╨╡╨▓╨╛╨╝ ╤Г╤З╨░╤Б╤В╨║╨╡
         P_values: ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨▓ %
 
     Returns:
         DataFrame: P_%, K_p, Q_max
     """
     if gauged_mean_annual <= 0:
         raise ValueError("╨б╤А╨╡╨┤╨╜╨╡╨│╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤ ╤Б╤В╤А╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛ ╤Г╤З╨░╤Б╤В╨║╨░ ╨┤╨╛╨╗╨╢╨╡╨╜ ╨▒╤Л╤В╤М > 0")
 
     if P_values is None:
         P_values = [0.1, 1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0, 33.0, 50.0]
 
     ratios = (gauged_max_series / gauged_mean_annual).dropna()
     if len(ratios) < 3:
         return pd.DataFrame({"P_%": P_values, "K_p": [np.nan] * len(P_values), "Q_max": [np.nan] * len(P_values)})
 
     stats_result = compute_basic_stats(ratios, use_normative_Cs=True)
     mean_k = stats_result["mean"]
     Cv = stats_result["Cv"]
     Cs = stats_result["Cs"]
 
     P_decimal = np.array(P_values) / 100.0
     from core.stats.frequency import pearson3_ppf
     K_p = pearson3_ppf(P_decimal, mean_k, Cv, Cs)
 
     Q_target = K_p * target_mean_annual
 
     return pd.DataFrame({
         "P_%": P_values,
         "K_p": np.round(K_p, 4),
         "Q_max": np.round(Q_target, 2)
     })
 
 
 def build_rating_curve(
     H: np.ndarray,
     Q: np.ndarray,
     H0: Optional[float] = None
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Я╨╛╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╤Д╤Г╨╜╨║╤Ж╨╕╨╛╨╜╨╕╤А╨╛╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╤П Q = a ├Ч (H - H0)^b.
 
     ╨Х╤Б╨╗╨╕ H0 ╨╜╨╡ ╨╖╨░╨┤╨░╨╜, ╨╛╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╤П╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╨║╨░╨║ ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╨╜╤М ╨▓╨╛╨┤╤Л ╨╜╨░ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╤Г.
 
     Parameters:
         H: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╜╨╡╨╣ ╨▓╨╛╨┤╤Л (╨╝)
         Q: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓ (╨╝┬│/╤Б)
         H0: ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╨╜╤М ╨╜╤Г╨╗╤П ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╨░ (╨╡╤Б╨╗╨╕ None тАФ ╨▒╨╡╤А╤С╤В╤Б╤П min(H))
 
     Returns:
         Dict: a, b, H0, R2, formula
     """
     H = np.asarray(H, dtype=float)
     Q = np.asarray(Q, dtype=float)
 
     mask = Q > 0
     H, Q = H[mask], Q[mask]
 
     if len(H) < 3:
         raise ValueError("╨Э╤Г╨╢╨╜╨╛ ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝ 3 ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨╕ ╤Б Q > 0")
 
     if H0 is None:
         H0 = float(np.min(H)) - 0.01
 
     dH = H - H0
     if np.any(dH <= 0):
         H0 = float(np.min(H)) - 0.01
         dH = H - H0
 
     log_dH = np.log(dH)
     log_Q = np.log(Q)
 
     slope, intercept, r_value, _, _ = stats.linregress(log_dH, log_Q)
     b = float(slope)
     a = float(np.exp(intercept))
     R2 = float(r_value ** 2)
 
     return {
         "a": round(a, 6),
         "b": round(b, 4),
         "H0": round(H0, 4),
         "R2": round(R2, 6),
         "formula": f"Q = {a:.4f} ├Ч (H - {H0:.2f})^{b:.4f}"
     }
 
 
 def discharge_from_level(H: float, params: Dict) -> float:
     """
     ╨а╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤ ╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╜╤О ╨▓╨╛╨┤╤Л: Q = a ├Ч (H - H0)^b.
     """
     a = params["a"]
     b = params["b"]
     H0 = params["H0"]
     dH = H - H0
     if dH <= 0:
         return 0.0
     return float(a * (dH ** b))
 
 
 def level_from_discharge(Q: float, params: Dict) -> float:
     """
     ╨г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╨╜╤М ╨▓╨╛╨┤╤Л ╨┐╨╛ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╤Г: H = H0 + (Q/a)^(1/b).
     """
     a = params["a"]
     b = params["b"]
     H0 = params["H0"]
     if Q <= 0 or a <= 0 or b == 0:
         return H0
     return float(H0 + (Q / a) ** (1.0 / b))

     data: np.ndarray,

     ╬╗2 = (mean - Q_med) / 2  (╨┤╨╗╤П ╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛)
     ╧Д3 = ╬╗3 / ╬╗2 (╨║╨╛╤Н╤Д╤Д╨╕╤Ж╨╕╨╡╨╜╤В ╨░╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╨╕ L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╛╨▓)

         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣

     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
     data_sorted = np.sort(data)
     n = len(data)

         return {'mean': float(np.mean(data)), 'cv': 0, 'cs': 0,
                 'lambda1': float(np.mean(data)), 'lambda2': 0, 'tau3': 0}
 
     w = weibull_plotting_position(n)

     b0 = np.mean(data_sorted)
     b1 = np.mean((1 - w) * data_sorted)
     b2 = np.mean((1 - w) ** 2 * data_sorted)

     l3 = 6 * b2 - 6 * b1 + b0

 def fit_gev(
     data: np.ndarray,
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Ю╨▒╨╛╨▒╤Й╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ (GEV) тАФ GenExtremum.
 
     F(x) = exp{-(1 + ╬╛(x-╬╝)/╧Г)^(-1/╬╛)}
 
     Parameters:
         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
 
     Returns:
         Dict: shape (╬╛), location (╬╝), scale (╧Г), aic, bic
     """
     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
 
     if len(data) < 10:
         return {'shape': 0, 'location': float(np.mean(data)),
                 'scale': float(np.std(data)), 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf}
 
     try:
         shape, loc, scale = stats.genextreme.fit(data)
 
         n = len(data)
         loglik = np.sum(stats.genextreme.logpdf(data, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale))
         aic = 2 * 3 - 2 * loglik
         bic = 3 * np.log(n) - 2 * loglik
 
         return {
             'shape_xi': round(float(-shape), 4),
             'location_mu': round(float(loc), 4),
             'scale_sigma': round(float(scale), 4),
             'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
             'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
             'bic': round(float(bic), 2),
             'n': n,
         }
     except Exception:
         return {'shape_xi': 0, 'location': float(np.mean(data)),
                 'scale': float(np.std(data)), 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf}

 def goodness_of_fit(
     data: np.ndarray,
     distribution: str = 'pearson3',
     params: Optional[Dict] = None,
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤В╨╡╤А╨╕╨╕ ╤Б╨╛╨│╨╗╨░╤Б╨╕╤П ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤Б ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╝╨╕.
 
     - ╧З┬▓ (╤Е╨╕-╨║╨▓╨░╨┤╤А╨░╤В)
     - K-S (╨Ъ╨╛╨╗╨╝╨╛╨│╨╛╤А╨╛╨▓-╨б╨╝╨╕╤А╨╜╨╛╨▓)
     - A-D (╨Р╨╜╨┤╨╡╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜-╨Ф╨░╤А╨╗╨╕╨╜╨│)
 
     Parameters:
         data: ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П
         distribution: 'pearson3', 'normal', 'lognormal', 'gamma', 'gev'
         params: ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╤Л ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П (╨╡╤Б╨╗╨╕ None тАФ ╨┐╨╛╨┤╨▒╨╕╤А╨░╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨╕╨╖ data)
 
     Returns:
         Dict: ks_stat, ks_p, ad_stat, chi2_stat, chi2_p
     """
     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
 
     results = {}
 
     try:
         ks_stat, ks_p = stats.kstest(data, distribution, args=()) if params is None else \
             stats.kstest(data, distribution)
         results['ks_stat'] = round(float(ks_stat), 4)
         results['ks_p'] = round(float(ks_p), 6)
     except (ValueError, TypeError):
         results['ks_stat'] = 0
         results['ks_p'] = 1
 
     try:
         ad_stat = stats.anderson(data, dist=distribution if distribution != 'pearson3' else 'norm')
         results['ad_stat'] = round(float(ad_stat.statistic), 4)
         results['ad_critical_values'] = [round(float(x), 3) for x in ad_stat.critical_values]
     except (ValueError, TypeError):
         results['ad_stat'] = 0
         results['ad_critical_values'] = []
 
     n_bins = max(5, int(np.sqrt(len(data))))
     observed, bin_edges = np.histogram(data, bins=n_bins)
 
     if params is None:
         try:
             if distribution == 'normal':
                 mu, sigma = stats.norm.fit(data)
                 expected = stats.norm.cdf(bin_edges, mu, sigma)
             elif distribution == 'lognormal':
                 shape, loc, scale = stats.lognorm.fit(data, floc=0)
                 expected = stats.lognorm.cdf(bin_edges, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale)
             elif distribution == 'gamma':
                 a, loc, scale = stats.gamma.fit(data, floc=0)
                 expected = stats.gamma.cdf(bin_edges, a, loc=loc, scale=scale)
             else:
                 mu, sigma = stats.norm.fit(data)
                 expected = stats.norm.cdf(bin_edges, mu, sigma)
 
             expected_freq = np.diff(expected) * len(data)
             expected_freq = np.maximum(expected_freq, 1)
 
             chi2_stat = np.sum((observed - expected_freq) ** 2 / expected_freq)
             df = n_bins - 3
             chi2_p = 1 - stats.chi2.cdf(chi2_stat, df) if df > 0 else 1
 
             results['chi2_stat'] = round(float(chi2_stat), 4)
             results['chi2_p'] = round(float(chi2_p), 6)
         except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
             results['chi2_stat'] = 0
             results['chi2_p'] = 1
 
     results['n'] = len(data)
     results['distribution'] = distribution
 
     return results

     ╨Ъ╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III ╤В╨╕╨┐╨░.
 
     X_p = X╠Д + ╧Г ┬╖ z_p,  ╧Г = X╠Д ┬╖ Cv
 
     ╨│╨┤╨╡ z_p тАФ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╤М ╤Б╤В╨░╨╜╨┤╨░╤А╤В╨╕╨╖╨╕╤А╨╛╨▓╨░╨╜╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III
     (╤Б ╨╜╤Г╨╗╨╡╨▓╤Л╨╝ ╤Б╤А╨╡╨┤╨╜╨╕╨╝, ╨╡╨┤╨╕╨╜╨╕╤З╨╜╤Л╨╝ ╨б╨Ъ╨Ю ╨╕ ╨╖╨░╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨░╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╨╡╨╣ Cs).
     ╨Ш╤Б╨┐╨╛╨╗╤М╨╖╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨░╤П ╤Д╤Г╨╜╨║╤Ж╨╕╤П ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П scipy (╨▓ ╨╛╤В╨╗╨╕╤З╨╕╨╡ ╨╛╤В
     ╨┐╤А╨╕╨▒╨╗╨╕╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╨Ъ╨╛╤А╨╜╨╕╤И╨░-╨д╨╕╤И╨╡╤А╨░, ╨║╨╛╤В╨╛╤А╨╛╨╡ ╨╜╨╡ ╤А╨░╨▒╨╛╤В╨░╨╡╤В ╨┐╤А╨╕ ╨▒╨╛╨╗╤М╤И╨╕╤Е Cs).
 
     ╨Ю╤В╤А╨╕╤Ж╨░╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ (╨╜╨╕╨╢╨╜╨╕╨╣ ╤Е╨▓╨╛╤Б╤В ╨┐╤А╨╕ Cs < 0 ╨╕ ╨▒╨╛╨╗╤М╤И╨╕╤Е P)
     ╨╛╨▒╤А╨╡╨╖╨░╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨┤╨╛ ╨╜╤Г╨╗╤П, ╨║╨░╨║ ╤Н╤В╨╛ ╨┤╨╡╨╗╨░╨╡╤В ╤Н╤В╨░╨╗╨╛╨╜╨╜╨░╤П ╨┐╤А╨╛╨│╤А╨░╨╝╨╝╨░.
     """
     probabilities = np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=float)
     cv = max(abs(cv), 0.001)
     cs = float(cs)
 
     quantiles = stats.pearson3.ppf(
         1 - probabilities, skew=cs, loc=mean, scale=mean * cv
     )
 
     return np.maximum(quantiles, 0.0)
 
 
 def kritsky_menkel_ppf(probabilities: np.ndarray, mean: float, cv: float, cs: float) -> np.ndarray:
     """
     ╨Ъ╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤Ж╨║╨╛╨│╨╛-╨Ь╨╡╨╜╨║╨╡╨╗╤П.
 
     ╨Ю╤Б╨╜╨╛╨▓╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ тАФ ╤В╤А╤С╤Е╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╡ ╨│╨░╨╝╨╝╨░-╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡:
        ╬▒ = 4/Cs┬▓,  ╬▓ = X╠Д┬╖Cv┬╖Cs/2,  AтВА = X╠Д┬╖(1 - 2Cv/Cs)
        X_p = AтВА + Gamma(╬▒, ╬▓)
 
     ╨б╨╛╨▓╨┐╨░╨┤╨░╨╡╤В ╤Б ╤Н╤В╨░╨╗╨╛╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨│╤А╨░╨╝╨╝╨╛╨╣ HydroStatCalc (╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤Ж╤Л KritkMenc.bin)
     ╨▓ ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨░╤Е ╨┐╨╛╨│╤А╨╡╤И╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤Ж. ╨Ю╤В╤А╨╕╤Ж╨░╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╨╛╨▒╤А╨╡╨╖╨░╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨┤╨╛ ╨╜╤Г╨╗╤П.
     """
     probabilities = np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=float)
     cv = max(abs(cv), 0.001)
     cs = float(cs)
     if abs(cs) < 0.001:
         cs = 0.001
 
     # --- ╨в╤А╤С╤Е╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╡ ╨│╨░╨╝╨╝╨░-╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ---
     alpha = 4.0 / (cs ** 2)                          # ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Л
-    beta = mean * cv * abs(cs) / 2.0                  # ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А ╨╝╨░╤Б╤И╤В╨░╨▒╨░
+    beta = mean * cv * cs / 2.0                  # ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А ╨╝╨░╤Б╤И╤В╨░╨▒╨░
     A0 = mean * (1.0 - 2.0 * cv / cs)               # ╨╜╨░╤З╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨░╤П ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨░ (╤Б╨┤╨▓╨╕╨│)
 
     try:
         quantiles = A0 + stats.gamma.ppf(1 - probabilities, a=alpha, scale=beta)
     except (ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError):
         # Fallback ╨╜╨░ ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╤Г ╨Ъ╨╛╤А╨╜╨╕╤И╨░-╨д╨╕╤И╨╡╤А╨░
         quantiles = pearson3_ppf(probabilities, mean, cv, cs)
 
     return np.maximum(quantiles, 0.0)
 
 
 def fit_theoretical_distributions(Q: np.ndarray, p_prob: np.ndarray) -> dict:
     """
     ╨Я╨╛╨┤╨│╨╛╨╜╤П╨╡╤В ╨╜╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╗╤М╨║╨╛ ╤В╨╡╨╛╤А╨╡╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╤Е ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣ ╨║ ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╝.
 
     Parameters:
         Q: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓
         p_prob: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨▓╨╡╤А╨╛╤П╤В╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╡╨╣ (0тАУ1) ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╡╨╣
 
     Returns:
         dict: {╨╜╨░╨╖╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╨╡: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓_╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╡╨╣ ╨╕╨╗╨╕ None}
     """
     probabilities = np.asarray(p_prob, dtype=float)
 
     # Pearson III (╤Б╨║╤М╤О-╨╜╨╛╤А╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡)
     try:
         params = stats.pearson3.fit(Q)
         p3 = stats.pearson3.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
     except (ValueError, TypeError):
         p3 = None
 
     # Gamma
     try:
         params = stats.gamma.fit(Q, floc=0)
         g = stats.gamma.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
     except (ValueError, TypeError):
         g = None
 
     # Lognormal
     try:
         params = stats.lognorm.fit(Q, floc=0)
         ln = stats.lognorm.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
     except (ValueError, TypeError):
         ln = None
 
     # Normal
     try:
         params = stats.norm.fit(Q)
         n = stats.norm.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
     except (ValueError, TypeError):
         n = None
 
     return {
         "pearson3": p3,
         "gamma": g,
         "lognormal": ln,
         "normal": n
     }
 
 
 def calculate_frequency_curve(
     data: np.ndarray,
     probabilities: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
     curve_type: CurveType = "pearson3",
     use_corrected: bool = True
 ) -> pd.DataFrame:
     """
     ╨Я╨╛╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╤А╨░╨╖╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤В╨╕╨┐╨╛╨▓.
     """
     if probabilities is None:
         probabilities = np.array([0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99])
 
     from core.stats.parameters import calculate_statistical_parameters
     params = calculate_statistical_parameters(data)
 
     mean = params['mean']
     cv = params['corrected_cv'] if use_corrected else params['cv']
     cs = params['corrected_cs'] if use_corrected else params['cs']
 
     if curve_type == "normal":
         std = params['std']
         quantiles = stats.norm.ppf(1 - probabilities, loc=mean, scale=std)
 
     elif curve_type == "pearson3":
         # ╨а╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III ╤В╨╕╨┐╨░ тАФ ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╨░ ╨Ъ╨╛╤А╨╜╨╕╤И╨░-╨д╨╕╤И╨╡╤А╨░
         quantiles = pearson3_ppf(probabilities, mean, cv, cs)
 
     elif curve_type == "kritsky_menkel":
         # ╨а╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤Ж╨║╨╛╨│╨╛-╨Ь╨╡╨╜╨║╨╡╨╗╤П тАФ ╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤З╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ / ╤В╤А╤С╤Е╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╡ ╨│╨░╨╝╨╝╨░
         quantiles = kritsky_menkel_ppf(probabilities, mean, cv, cs)
 
     elif curve_type == "empirical":
         # ╨а╤П╨┤ ╤Б╨╛╤А╤В╨╕╤А╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╨▒╤Л╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╤О: m=1 тАФ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╤З╨╗╨╡╨╜ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░,
         # ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨░╤П ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М P_m = (m - 0.3)/(n + 0.4).
         q_desc = np.sort(data)[::-1]
         n = len(q_desc)
         emp_probs = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
         quantiles = np.interp(probabilities, emp_probs, q_desc,
                               left=q_desc[0], right=q_desc[-1])
 
     elif curve_type == "piecewise":
         # ╨Ш╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨┐╨╛╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╤П ╨╗╨╛╨╝╨░╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╡╨╣ (╨У╨У╨Ш):
         # ╨в╨╛╤З╨║╨╕ ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╣ ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╨╗╨╡╨┤╨╛╨▓╨░╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛ ╤Б╨╛╨╡╨┤╨╕╨╜╤П╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨╛╤В╤А╨╡╨╖╨║╨░╨╝╨╕
         # ╨┐╤А╤П╨╝╤Л╤Е. ╨а╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ тАФ ╨┐╨╛ ╨║╨╛╨╛╤А╨┤╨╕╨╜╨░╤В╨░╨╝ ╤Н╤В╨╕╤Е ╨╛╤В╤А╨╡╨╖╨║╨╛╨▓.
         q_desc = np.sort(data)[::-1]
         n = len(q_desc)
         emp_probs = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
         # ╨Ы╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╣╨╜╨░╤П ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨┐╨╛╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╤П ╨╝╨╡╨╢╨┤╤Г ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╝╨╕ ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨░╨╝╨╕
         quantiles = np.interp(probabilities, emp_probs, q_desc,
                               left=q_desc[0], right=q_desc[-1])
 
     elif curve_type == "none":
         quantiles = np.full_like(probabilities, np.nan)
     else:
         std = params['std']
         quantiles = stats.norm.ppf(1 - probabilities, loc=mean, scale=std)
 
     return pd.DataFrame({
         'P_%': np.round(probabilities * 100, 2),
         'Q': np.round(quantiles, 2)
     })

 def auto_select_cs_cv(

     p_range: Optional[tuple] = None,
     precision: float = 0.05,
     cs_cv_min: float = -2.0,
     cs_cv_max: float = 6.0,
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Р╨▓╤В╨╛╨╝╨░╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╣ ╨┐╨╛╨┤╨▒╨╛╤А ╨╛╤В╨╜╨╛╤И╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П Cs/Cv ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕.
 
     ╨Р╨╗╨│╨╛╤А╨╕╤В╨╝ (╨У╨У╨Ш):
     1. ╨Т╤Л╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╨╕╤В╤М ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╡ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨┐╨╛ ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╨╡ ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤Ж╨║╨╛╨│╨╛-╨Ь╨╡╨╜╨║╨╡╨╗╤П
        P = (m - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
     2. ╨Я╨╡╤А╨╡╨▒╤А╨░╤В╤М Cs/Cv ╨╛╤В cs_cv_min ╨┤╨╛ cs_cv_max ╤Б ╤И╨░╨│╨╛╨╝ precision
     3. ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨║╨░╨╢╨┤╨╛╨│╨╛ Cs/Cv: ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨╕╤В╤М ╤В╨╡╨╛╤А╨╡╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╤Г╤О ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╤Г╤О (╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜ III ╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╨Ъ-╨Ь)
     4. ╨Т╤Л╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╨╕╤В╤М╬г(Y╤Н╨╝╨┐ - Y╤В╨╡╨╛╤А)┬▓ ╨┐╨╛ ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨░╨╝ ╨▓ ╨╖╨░╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╝ ╨┤╨╕╨░╨┐╨░╨╖╨╛╨╜╨╡ P
     5. ╨Т╤Л╨▒╤А╨░╤В╤М Cs/Cv ╤Б ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤Б╤Г╨╝╨╝╨╛╨╣
 
     ╨Р╤А╨│╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╤Л:

 - ╨Ь╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┐╨╛╤А╤Ж╨╕╨╣ (Q╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В = k ├Ч Q╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│)
 - ╨Я╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨║╨░ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╤Б╨▓╤П╨╖╨╕ (R > Ro ╨║╤А╨╕╤В)
 - ╨Ю╤Ж╨╡╨╜╨║╨░ ╨┐╨╛╨│╤А╨╡╤И╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╤Г╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░
 
 ╨Ю╤Б╨╜╨╛╨▓╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╤Д╤Г╨╜╨║╤Ж╨╕╨╕:
 - validate_correlation тАФ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨║╨░ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨║╨╛╤А╤А╨╡╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╨╕
 - regression_extension тАФ ╤А╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╛╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╤Г╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П
 - proportional_extension тАФ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┐╨╛╤А╤Ж╨╕╨╣
 - estimate_extension_error тАФ ╨╛╤Ж╨╡╨╜╨║╨░ ╨┐╨╛╨│╤А╨╡╤И╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕
 - full_extension_workflow тАФ ╨┐╨╛╨╗╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╤Ж╨╕╨║╨╗ ╤Г╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П
 """
 
 import numpy as np
 import pandas as pd
 from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
 from scipy import stats
 
 
 # ╨в╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤З╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П Ro ╨║╤А╨╕╤В (╨б╨Я 33-101-2003, ╨в╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤Ж╨░ 3)
 # ╨Ъ╨╗╤О╤З: (n_common, alpha=0.05)
 RO_CRITICAL = {
     5: 0.878, 6: 0.811, 7: 0.754, 8: 0.707, 9: 0.666, 10: 0.632,
     11: 0.602, 12: 0.576, 13: 0.553, 14: 0.532, 15: 0.514,
     16: 0.497, 17: 0.482, 18: 0.468, 19: 0.456, 20: 0.444,
     25: 0.396, 30: 0.361, 35: 0.335, 40: 0.314, 50: 0.282,
     60: 0.259, 80: 0.226, 100: 0.203, 150: 0.166, 200: 0.143
 }
 
 
 def get_ro_critical(n: int, alpha: float = 0.05) -> float:
     """
     ╨Я╨╛╨╗╤Г╤З╨╕╤В╤М ╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤З╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ Ro ╨║╤А╨╕╤В ╨┤╨╗╤П n ╨╛╨▒╤Й╨╕╤Е ╨╗╨╡╤В.
 
     ╨Х╤Б╨╗╨╕ ╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛╨╡ n ╨╜╨╡╤В ╨▓ ╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤Ж╨╡ тАФ ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨┐╨╛╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╤П.
     """
     keys = sorted(RO_CRITICAL.keys())
     if n < keys[0]:
         return 1.0
     if n > keys[-1]:
         return RO_CRITICAL[keys[-1]]
 
     for i in range(len(keys) - 1):
         if keys[i] <= n <= keys[i + 1]:
             frac = (n - keys[i]) / (keys[i + 1] - keys[i])
             return RO_CRITICAL[keys[i]] + frac * (RO_CRITICAL[keys[i + 1]] - RO_CRITICAL[keys[i]])
 
     return RO_CRITICAL[keys[-1]]
 
 
 def validate_correlation(
     Q_calc: pd.Series,
     Q_analog: pd.Series,
     alpha: float = 0.05
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Я╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨║╨░ ╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╣ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨║╨╛╤А╤А╨╡╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╨╛╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤Б╨▓╤П╨╖╨╕.
 
     ╨б╨Я 33-101-2003 ╨┐. 6.2.3: ╤Б╨▓╤П╨╖╤М ╨┐╤А╨╕╨╖╨╜╨░╤С╤В╤Б╤П ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╤А╨╕ R > Ro(╬▒, n).
 
     Parameters:
         Q_calc: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕
         Q_analog: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕-╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│╨░
         alpha: ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╨╜╤М ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕
 
     Returns:
         Dict: R, Ro_crit, n_common, is_significant, quality_class
     """
     common_idx = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
     n = len(common_idx)
 
     if n < 5:
         return {
             'R': 0, 'Ro_crit': 1.0, 'n_common': n,
             'is_significant': False,
             'quality_class': '╨Э╨╡╤В ╤Б╨▓╤П╨╖╨╕ (n < 5)'
         }
 
     Qc = Q_calc.loc[common_idx].values
     Qa = Q_analog.loc[common_idx].values
 
     R, p_value = stats.pearsonr(Qa, Qc)
     Ro = get_ro_critical(n, alpha)
 
     R2 = R ** 2
 
     if R > 0.95:
         quality = '╨Ю╤В╨╗╨╕╤З╨╜╨░╤П (R┬▓ > 0.90)'
     elif R > 0.90:
         quality = '╨е╨╛╤А╨╛╤И╨░╤П (R┬▓ > 0.81)'
     elif R > 0.80:
         quality = '╨г╨┤╨╛╨▓╨╗╨╡╤В╨▓╨╛╤А╨╕╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨░╤П (R┬▓ > 0.64)'
     elif R > 0.70:
         quality = '╨б╨╗╨░╨▒╨░╤П (R┬▓ > 0.49)'
     else:
         quality = '╨Э╨╡╤Г╨┤╨╛╨▓╨╗╨╡╤В╨▓╨╛╤А╨╕╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨░╤П (R┬▓ < 0.49)'
 
     return {
         'R': round(float(R), 4),
         'R2': round(float(R2), 4),
         'Ro_crit': round(Ro, 4),
         'n_common': n,
         'is_significant': float(R) > float(Ro),
         'p_value': round(float(p_value), 6),
         'quality_class': quality
     }
 
 
 def regression_extension(
     Q_calc: pd.Series,
     Q_analog: pd.Series
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨а╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╛╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤А╤П╨┤╨░.
 
     Q╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В = a ├Ч Q╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│ + b
 
     Parameters:
         Q_calc: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕ (╨║╨╛╤А╨╛╤В╨║╨╕╨╣)
         Q_analog: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕-╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│╨░ (╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣)
 
     Returns:
         Dict: a, b, R, n_common, validation, extended_series
     """
     validation = validate_correlation(Q_calc, Q_analog)
     if not validation['is_significant']:
         pass  # ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╤Г╨┐╤А╨╡╨╢╨┤╨░╨╡╨╝, ╨╜╨╛ ╨╜╨╡ ╨▒╨╗╨╛╨║╨╕╤А╤Г╨╡╨╝
 
     common_idx = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
     if len(common_idx) < 2:
         raise ValueError("╨Э╨╡╨┤╨╛╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛ ╨╛╨▒╤Й╨╕╤Е ╨╗╨╡╤В ╨┤╨╗╤П ╤А╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╕ (╨╜╤Г╨╢╨╜╨╛ тЙе 2)")
 
     Qc = Q_calc.loc[common_idx]
     Qa = Q_analog.loc[common_idx]
     result = stats.linregress(Qa.values, Qc.values)
     a = float(result.slope)
     b = float(result.intercept)
 
     Q_ext = Q_analog.copy().astype(float)
 
     missing = Q_analog.index.difference(Q_calc.index)
     if len(missing) > 0:
         Q_ext.loc[missing] = a * Q_analog.loc[missing] + b
 
     common = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
     Q_ext.loc[common] = Q_calc.loc[common]
 
     return {
         'a': round(a, 6),
         'b': round(b, 4),
         'R': validation['R'],
         'R2': validation['R2'],
         'Ro_crit': validation['Ro_crit'],
         'n_common': validation['n_common'],
         'is_significant': validation['is_significant'],
         'quality_class': validation['quality_class'],
         'extended_series': Q_ext,
         'warning': None if validation['is_significant'] else
                    f"R={validation['R']:.3f} < Ro={validation['Ro_crit']:.3f}. ╨б╨▓╤П╨╖╤М ╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕ ╨╜╨╡╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨░!"
     }
 
 
 def proportional_extension(
     Q_calc: pd.Series,
     Q_analog: pd.Series
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Ь╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┐╨╛╤А╤Ж╨╕╨╣ ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤А╤П╨┤╨░.
 
     Q╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В = k ├Ч Q╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│, ╨│╨┤╨╡ k = Q╤Б╤А_╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В / Q╤Б╤А_╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│
 
     Parameters:
         Q_calc: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕ (╨║╨╛╤А╨╛╤В╨║╨╕╨╣)
         Q_analog: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕-╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│╨░ (╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣)
 
     Returns:
         Dict: k, Q_mean_calc, Q_mean_analog, extended_series
     """
     common_idx = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
     if len(common_idx) < 2:
         raise ValueError("╨Э╨╡╨┤╨╛╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛ ╨╛╨▒╤Й╨╕╤Е ╨╗╨╡╤В")
 
     Qc_mean = float(Q_calc.loc[common_idx].mean())
     Qa_mean = float(Q_analog.loc[common_idx].mean())
 
     k = Qc_mean / Qa_mean if Qa_mean != 0 else 1.0
 
     Q_ext = Q_analog.copy().astype(float) * k
 
     common = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
     Q_ext.loc[common] = Q_calc.loc[common]
 
     return {
         'k': round(k, 6),
         'Q_mean_calc': round(Qc_mean, 4),
         'Q_mean_analog': round(Qa_mean, 4),
         'extended_series': Q_ext
     }
 
 
 def estimate_extension_error(
     Q_calc: pd.Series,
     Q_analog: pd.Series,
     regression_result: Dict
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Ю╤Ж╨╡╨╜╨║╨░ ╨┐╨╛╨│╤А╨╡╤И╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░.
 
     ╨б╨Я 33-101-2003 ╨┐. 6.2.4:
     ╬╡ = (Cv / sqrt(n)) ├Ч Kr ├Ч 100%
 
     ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░:
     ╬╡_╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗ = ╬╡_╨╕╤Б╤Е ├Ч sqrt(n_╨╕╤Б╤Е / n_╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗)
 
     Parameters:
         Q_calc: ╨╕╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╜╤Л╨╣ (╨║╨╛╤А╨╛╤В╨║╨╕╨╣) ╤А╤П╨┤
         Q_analog: ╤А╤П╨┤-╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│ (╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣)
         regression_result: ╤А╨╡╨╖╤Г╨╗╤М╤В╨░╤В regression_extension
 
     Returns:
         Dict: epsilon_original, epsilon_extended, n_original, n_extended, reliability
     """
     n_orig = len(Q_calc.dropna())
     n_ext = len(Q_analog.dropna())
 
     Cv_orig = float(Q_calc.std() / Q_calc.mean()) if Q_calc.mean() != 0 else 0
 
     R = regression_result.get('R', 0.8)
     r = 0.5
     K_r = np.sqrt((1 + r) / (1 - r)) if r < 1 else 1.0
 
     eps_orig = (Cv_orig / np.sqrt(n_orig)) * K_r * 100
     eps_ext = (Cv_orig / np.sqrt(n_ext)) * K_r * 100
 
     if eps_ext <= 10:
         reliability = '╨Э╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨░╤П'
     elif eps_ext <= 15:
         reliability = '╨Я╨╛╨╜╨╕╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╜╨░╤П ╨╜╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М'
     else:
         reliability = '╨Э╨╡╨╜╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╨░╤П'
 
     return {
         'epsilon_original': round(eps_orig, 2),
         'epsilon_extended': round(eps_ext, 2),
         'n_original': n_orig,
         'n_extended': n_ext,
         'Cv': round(Cv_orig, 4),
         'reliability': reliability,
         'improvement_pct': round((eps_orig - eps_ext) / eps_orig * 100, 1) if eps_orig > 0 else 0
     }
 
 
 def full_extension_workflow(
     Q_calc: pd.Series,
     Q_analog: pd.Series,
     method: str = 'regression'
 ) -> Dict:
     """
     ╨Я╨╛╨╗╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╤Ж╨╕╨║╨╗ ╤Г╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤А╤П╨┤╨░ ╤Б ╨▓╨░╨╗╨╕╨┤╨░╤Ж╨╕╨╡╨╣.
 
     Parameters:
         Q_calc: ╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╤Л╨╣ (╨║╨╛╤А╨╛╤В╨║╨╕╨╣) ╤А╤П╨┤
         Q_analog: ╤А╤П╨┤-╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│ (╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣)
         method: 'regression' ╨╕╨╗╨╕ 'proportional'
 
     Returns:
         Dict: validation, extension_result, error_estimate, warnings
     """
     warnings = []
 
     validation = validate_correlation(Q_calc, Q_analog)
 
     if not validation['is_significant']:
         warnings.append(
             f"╨Ъ╨а╨Ш╨в╨Ш╨з╨Э╨Ю: R={validation['R']:.3f} < Ro({validation['n_common']})={validation['Ro_crit']:.3f}. "
             f"╨Ъ╨╛╤А╤А╨╡╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╤П ╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕ ╨╜╨╡╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨░! ╨а╨╡╨╖╤Г╨╗╤М╤В╨░╤В╤Л ╨╝╨╛╨│╤Г╤В ╨▒╤Л╤В╤М ╨╜╨╡╨┤╨╛╤Б╤В╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨╜╤Л╨╝╨╕."
         )
 
     if validation['n_common'] < 10:
         warnings.append(
             f"╨Ь╨░╨╗╨╛ ╨╛╨▒╤Й╨╕╤Е ╨╗╨╡╤В ({validation['n_common']}). ╨а╨╡╨║╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╨┤╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П тЙе 10."
         )
 
     if method == 'regression':
         ext_result = regression_extension(Q_calc, Q_analog)
     else:
         ext_result = proportional_extension(Q_calc, Q_analog)
 
     error_est = estimate_extension_error(Q_calc, Q_analog, ext_result)
 
     if error_est['epsilon_extended'] > 15:
         warnings.append(
             f"╬╡ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╨╗╨╡ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П = {error_est['epsilon_extended']:.1f}% > 15%. "
             f"╨а╤П╨┤ ╨╛╤Б╤В╨░╤С╤В╤Б╤П ╨╜╨╡╨╜╨░╨┤╤С╨╢╨╜╤Л╨╝."
         )
 
     return {
         'validation': validation,
         'extension_result': ext_result,
         'error_estimate': error_est,
         'warnings': warnings,
         'extended_series': ext_result.get('extended_series'),
         'method': method
     }
 
 
 def multi_analog_extension(
     Q_calc: pd.Series,
     analogs: Dict[str, pd.Series],
     n_min: int = 6,
     ro_cr: float = 0.7,
     ro_over_sigma: float = 2.0,
     k_over_sigma: float = 2.0,
     y_over_sigma: float = 0.2,
     max_analogs: int = 3,
     exclude_negative: bool = True,

 def clean_column_name(name) -> str:
     """╨Э╨╛╤А╨╝╨░╨╗╨╕╨╖╨╛╨▓╨░╤В╤М ╨╕╨╝╤П ╨║╨╛╨╗╨╛╨╜╨║╨╕: lower ╨╕ ╤Б╨╜╤П╤В╤М ╨╡╨┤╨╕╨╜╨╕╤Ж╤Л ╨╕╨╖╨╝╨╡╤А╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П.
 
     ┬лH, ╨╝┬╗ -> "h", ┬лQ, ╨╝┬│/╤Б┬╗ -> "q", ┬л╨а╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤ Q, ╨╝┬│/╤Б┬╗ -> "╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤ q",
     ┬л╨С╨░╨╖╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╣ ╤Б╤В╨╛╨║, ╨╝┬│/╤Б┬╗ -> "╨▒╨░╨╖╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╣ ╤Б╤В╨╛╨║", ┬л╨У╨╛╨┤┬╗ -> "╨│╨╛╨┤".
     ╨б╨╗╨╛╨▓╨╛ ┬л╨│╨╛╨┤┬╗ ╨Э╨Х ╤Г╨┤╨░╨╗╤П╨╡╤В╤Б╤П (╤Н╤В╨╛ ╨║╨╛╨╗╨╛╨╜╨║╨░-╨│╨╛╨┤).
     """
     s = str(name).strip().lower()
     s = s.replace("┬│", "3").replace("┬▓", "2")
     s = _COMPOUND_UNITS.sub(" ", s)
     s = _SEPARATORS.sub(" ", s)
     s = _SINGLE_UNITS.sub(" ", s)
     s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
     return s
 
 
 def find_sheet(xls: pd.ExcelFile, keywords: Sequence[str]) -> Optional[str]:
     """╨Э╨░╨╣╤В╨╕ ╨╕╨╝╤П ╨╗╨╕╤Б╤В╨░ ╤Б ╤Б╨░╨╝╤Л╨╝ ╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╝ ╤Б╨╛╨▓╨┐╨░╨▓╤И╨╕╨╝ ╨║╨╗╤О╤З╨╡╨▓╤Л╨╝ ╤Б╨╗╨╛╨▓╨╛╨╝.
 
     ╨Я╤А╨╛╨▒╨╡╨╗╤Л ╨╕╨│╨╜╨╛╤А╨╕╤А╤Г╤О╤В╤Б╤П, ╤З╤В╨╛╨▒╤Л ┬лFDC + ╨а╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╕┬╗ ╨╝╨░╤В╤З╨╕╨╗ ╨╕ ╨╗╨╕╤Б╤В ┬лFDC + ╨а╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╕ + ╨б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╨║╨░┬╗.
     ╨Я╤А╨╕ ╤А╨░╨▓╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╡ ╨║╨╗╤О╤З╨░ ╨┐╨╛╨▒╨╡╨╢╨┤╨░╨╡╤В ╨╗╨╕╤Б╤В, ╨▓╤Б╤В╤А╨╡╤З╨░╤О╤Й╨╕╨╣╤Б╤П ╤А╨░╨╜╤М╤И╨╡.
     """
     lower_keywords = [str(k).strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
                       for k in keywords if str(k).strip()]
     best = None  # (score, order, name)
     for order, sn in enumerate(xls.sheet_names):
         sn_lower = sn.strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
         for kw in lower_keywords:
             if kw in sn_lower:
                 score = len(kw)
                 if best is None or score > best[0] or (score == best[0] and order < best[1]):
                     best = (score, order, sn)
     return best[2] if best else None
 
 
 def find_header_row(raw: pd.DataFrame, header_keywords: Sequence[str],
                     max_scan: int = 15) -> int:
     """╨Э╨░╨╣╤В╨╕ ╨╕╨╜╨┤╨╡╨║╤Б ╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨║╨╕-╨╖╨░╨│╨╛╨╗╨╛╨▓╨║╨░, ╤Б╨╛╨┤╨╡╤А╨╢╨░╤Й╨╡╨╣ ╨╛╨┤╨╜╨╛ ╨╕╨╖ ╨║╨╗╤О╤З╨╡╨▓╤Л╤Е ╤Б╨╗╨╛╨▓.
 
     ╨п╤З╨╡╨╣╨║╨╕ ╤З╨╕╤Б╤В╤П╤В╤Б╤П ╤З╨╡╤А╨╡╨╖ clean_column_name, ╨┐╨╛╤Н╤В╨╛╨╝╤Г ┬лH, ╨╝┬╗ ╨╝╨░╤В╤З╨╕╤В╤Б╤П ╨┐╨╛ ┬лh┬╗.
     ╨Ф╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╤В╨╕╤В╤Г╨╗╤Л/╨┐╨╛╨┤╤Б╨║╨░╨╖╨║╨╕ (╤Б╨╛╨┤╨╡╤А╨╢╨░╤Й╨╕╨╡ ┬л╨│╨╛╨┤┬╗, ┬л╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤┬╗ ╨▓╨╜╤Г╤В╤А╨╕ ╤Б╨╗╨╛╨▓) ╨╛╤В╤Б╨╡╨║╨░╤О╤В╤Б╤П
     ╨╛╨│╤А╨░╨╜╨╕╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡╨╝ ╨╜╨░ ╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╤Г: len(nc) <= len(kw) + 3.
     """
     lower_keys = [str(k).strip().lower() for k in header_keywords if str(k).strip()]
     for idx in range(min(max_scan, len(raw))):
         cells = [str(v).strip().lower() for v in raw.iloc[idx].tolist() if pd.notna(v)]
         for c in cells:
             nc = clean_column_name(c)
             if not nc:
                 continue
             for kw in lower_keys:
                 if kw == nc or (kw in nc and len(nc) <= len(kw) + 3):
                     return idx
     return -1

                     sheet_keywords: Sequence[str],
                     header_keywords: Sequence[str] = ("╨│╨╛╨┤", "year", "years"),
                     use_columns: bool = False) -> pd.DataFrame:
     """╨Я╤А╨╛╤З╨╕╤В╨░╤В╤М ╤А╨░╨▒╨╛╤З╨╕╨╣ ╨╗╨╕╤Б╤В ╤И╨░╨▒╨╗╨╛╨╜╨░, ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┐╤Г╤Б╤В╨╕╨▓ ╤В╨╕╤В╤Г╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨║╨╕.
 
     Args:
         filepath_or_xls: ╨┐╤Г╤В╤М ╨║ ╤Д╨░╨╣╨╗╤Г Excel ╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╨╛╤В╨║╤А╤Л╤В╤Л╨╣ pd.ExcelFile.
         sheet_keywords: ╨║╨╗╤О╤З╨╡╨▓╤Л╨╡ ╤Б╨╗╨╛╨▓╨░ ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╨╛╨╕╤Б╨║╨░ ╨╗╨╕╤Б╤В╨░ (╨╜╨░╨┐╤А╨╕╨╝╨╡╤А ["FDC + ╨а╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╕ + ╨б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╨║╨░", "FDC"]).
         header_keywords: ╤Б╨╗╨╛╨▓╨░ ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╨╛╨╕╤Б╨║╨░ ╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨║╨╕-╨╖╨░╨│╨╛╨╗╨╛╨▓╨║╨░.

             ╨╕╨╜╨░╤З╨╡ ╤З╨╕╤В╨░╤В╤М ╤Б skiprows=header_row.
 
     Returns:
         pd.DataFrame ╤Б ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╝╨╕; ╨┐╤Г╤Б╤В╨╛╨╣ DataFrame, ╨╡╤Б╨╗╨╕ ╨╗╨╕╤Б╤В ╨╜╨╡ ╨╜╨░╨╣╨┤╨╡╨╜.
     """
     xls = filepath_or_xls if isinstance(filepath_or_xls, pd.ExcelFile) else pd.ExcelFile(filepath_or_xls)
     sheet = find_sheet(xls, sheet_keywords)
     if sheet is None:
         return pd.DataFrame()
 
     raw = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet, header=None)
     header_idx = find_header_row(raw, header_keywords)
     if header_idx < 0:

         df = raw.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
         df.columns = [str(c) for c in raw.iloc[header_idx].values]

+def linear_trend(years, values):
+    """╨Ы╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╣╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╤В╤А╨╡╨╜╨┤ ╤Б ╨┤╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨╕╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╝ ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨▓╨░╨╗╨╛╨╝"""
+    slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(years, values)

+    # ╨Ф╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨╕╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨▓╨░╨╗ ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨╜╨░╨║╨╗╨╛╨╜╨░ (95%)

+def mann_kendall_test(values):
+    """╨в╨╡╤Б╤В ╨Ь╨░╨╜╨╜╨░-╨Ъ╨╡╨╜╨┤╨░╨╗╨╗╨░ (╨▓╨╡╨║╤В╨╛╤А╨╕╨╖╨╛╨▓╨░╨╜╨╜╨░╤П ╤А╨╡╨░╨╗╨╕╨╖╨░╤Ж╨╕╤П)."""
+    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
+    n = len(values)

+    if s > 0:

+def sens_slope(years, values):
+    """╨Э╨░╨║╨╗╨╛╨╜ ╨б╨╡╨╜╨░"""

     def _toggle_mode(self, checked):

     def _parse_values(self, text):
         vals = []
         for line in text.strip().split('\n'):
             line = line.strip()
             if not line:
                 continue
             for part in line.replace(';', ',').split(','):
                 part = part.strip()
                 if part:
                     try:
                         vals.append(float(part.replace(',', '.')))
                     except ValueError:
                         pass
         return vals
 
     def _update_preview(self):
         years_text = self.edit_years.toPlainText() if self.radio_years_values.isChecked() else ""
         values_text = self.edit_values.toPlainText()
 
         values = self._parse_values(values_text)
 
         if self.radio_years_values.isChecked() and years_text:
             years = self._parse_values(years_text)
             n = min(len(years), len(values))
             self.preview_table.setRowCount(n)
             for i in range(n):
                 self.preview_table.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(int(years[i]) if years[i] == int(years[i]) else years[i])))
                 self.preview_table.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(f"{values[i]:.4f}"))
         else:
             self.preview_table.setRowCount(len(values))
             for i, v in enumerate(values):
                 self.preview_table.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(i + 1)))
                 self.preview_table.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(f"{v:.4f}"))
 
     def _validate_and_accept(self):
         values = self._parse_values(self.edit_values.toPlainText())
         if len(values) < 2:
             QMessageBox.warning(self, "╨Ю╤И╨╕╨▒╨║╨░", "╨Э╤Г╨╢╨╜╨╛ ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝ 2 ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П")
             return
         if self.radio_years_values.isChecked():
             years = self._parse_values(self.edit_years.toPlainText())
             if len(years) == 0:
                 QMessageBox.warning(self, "╨Ю╤И╨╕╨▒╨║╨░", "╨Т╨▓╨╡╨┤╨╕╤В╨╡ ╨│╨╛╨┤╤Л")
                 return
             if len(years) != len(values):
                 QMessageBox.warning(self, "╨Ю╤И╨╕╨▒╨║╨░",
                     f"╨Ъ╨╛╨╗╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╤В╨▓╨╛ ╨╗╨╡╤В ({len(years)}) ╨╜╨╡ ╤Б╨╛╨▓╨┐╨░╨┤╨░╨╡╤В ╤Б ╨║╨╛╨╗╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╤В╨▓╨╛╨╝ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣ ({len(values)})")
                 return
         self.accept()
 
     def paste_from_clipboard(self):
         from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication
         clipboard = QApplication.clipboard()
         text = clipboard.text()
         if text:
             if self.radio_years_values.isChecked():
                 self.edit_years.setPlainText(text)
             else:
                 self.edit_values.setPlainText(text)
 
     def get_data(self):
         values = self._parse_values(self.edit_values.toPlainText())
         post_name = self.edit_post.text().strip() or "╨Я╨╛╤Б╤В 1"
 
         if self.radio_years_values.isChecked():
             years = self._parse_values(self.edit_years.toPlainText())
             import pandas as pd
             df = pd.DataFrame({
                 'year': [int(y) for y in years],
                 'value': values
             })
         else:
             import pandas as pd
             df = pd.DataFrame({
                 'year': list(range(1, len(values) + 1)),
                 'value': values
             })
 
         return post_name, df

     def _make_post_combo(self):
         """╨б╨╛╨╖╨┤╨░╤В╤М ╤Б╨╕╨╜╤Е╤А╨╛╨╜╨╕╨╖╨╕╤А╨╛╨▓╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨║╨╛╨╝╨▒╨╛╨▒╨╛╨║╤Б ╨▓╤Л╨▒╨╛╤А╨░ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╨░."""
         combo = QComboBox()
         combo.setMinimumWidth(160)
         combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self.on_post_changed)
         self._post_combos.append(combo)
         return combo
 
     def _populate_post_combos(self):
         """╨Ч╨░╨┐╨╛╨╗╨╜╨╕╤В╤М ╨▓╤Б╨╡ ╨║╨╛╨╝╨▒╨╛ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╨╛╨▓ (╨│╨╗╨░╨▓╨╜╤Л╨╣ + ╨▓╨║╨╗╨░╨┤╨║╨╕)."""
         for combo in [self.combo_post] + self._post_combos:
             combo.blockSignals(True)
             combo.clear()
             combo.addItems(self.available_posts)
             combo.blockSignals(False)
 
     def _sync_post_combos(self, active):
         """╨б╨╕╨╜╤Е╤А╨╛╨╜╨╕╨╖╨╕╤А╨╛╨▓╨░╤В╤М ╨▓╤Б╨╡ ╨║╨╛╨╝╨▒╨╛ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╨╛╨▓ ╤Б ╤В╨╡╨║╤Г╤Й╨╕╨╝ ╨▓╤Л╨▒╨╛╤А╨╛╨╝."""
         for combo in [self.combo_post] + self._post_combos:
             if combo.currentText() != active:
                 combo.blockSignals(True)
                 idx = combo.findText(active)
                 combo.setCurrentIndex(idx if idx >= 0 else 0)
                 combo.blockSignals(False)

     def detect_outliers(self):
         if self.df is None or len(self.df) < 10:
             QMessageBox.warning(self, "╨Ь╨░╨╗╨╛ ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╤Е", "╨Э╤Г╨╢╨╜╨╛ ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝ 10 ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣")
             return
         try:
             values = self.df['value'].values
             years = self.df['year'].values if 'year' in self.df.columns else np.arange(len(values))
             
             z_scores = np.abs(stats.zscore(values))
             z_outliers = np.where(z_scores > 3)[0]
             
             q1, q3 = np.percentile(values, [25, 75])
             iqr = q3 - q1
             lower = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
             upper = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
             iqr_outliers = np.where((values < lower) | (values > upper))[0]
             
             outlier_idx = np.unique(np.concatenate([z_outliers, iqr_outliers]))
             
             if len(outlier_idx) == 0:
                 QMessageBox.information(self, "╨а╨╡╨╖╤Г╨╗╤М╤В╨░╤В", "╨Т╤Л╨┤╨░╤О╤Й╨╕╤Е╤Б╤П ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣ ╨╜╨╡ ╨╛╨▒╨╜╨░╤А╤Г╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╛")
                 return
             
             self.table.setRowCount(len(outlier_idx) + 1)
             self.table.setItem(0, 0, QTableWidgetItem("╨У╨╛╨┤ / ╨Ш╨╜╨┤╨╡╨║╤Б"))
             self.table.setItem(0, 1, QTableWidgetItem("╨Ч╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ | Z-score"))
             
             for i, idx in enumerate(outlier_idx):

                 f"╨Ю╨▒╨╜╨░╤А╤Г╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╛ {len(outlier_idx)} ╨▓╤Л╨┤╨░╤О╤Й╨╕╤Е╤Б╤П ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣.\n\n╨а╨╡╨║╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╨┤╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╨┐╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╤А╨╕╤В╤М ╨╕╤Е.")

51: def mle_pearson3(
52:     data: np.ndarray,
53:     max_iter: int = 500,
54: ) -> Dict:
55:     """
56:     ╨Ю╤Ж╨╡╨╜╨║╨░ ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╛╨▓ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤╨╛╨╝ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛ ╨┐╤А╨░╨▓╨┤╨╛╨┐╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▒╨╕╤П (MLE).
57: 
58:     ╨Я╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╤Л: mean, cv, cs
59: 
60:     Parameters:
61:         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
62:         max_iter: ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╨╛ ╨╕╤В╨╡╤А╨░╤Ж╨╕╨╣ ╨╛╨┐╤В╨╕╨╝╨╕╨╖╨░╤Ж╨╕╨╕
63: 
64:     Returns:
65:         Dict: mean, cv, cs, loglik, aic, bic, success
66:     """
67:     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
68:     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
69:     n = len(data)
70: 
71:     if n < 5:
72:         return {'mean': float(np.mean(data)), 'cv': 0, 'cs': 0,
73:                 'loglik': -np.inf, 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf, 'success': False}
74: 
75:     x0 = [float(np.mean(data)), float(np.std(data, ddof=1) / np.mean(data)), 0.0]
76: 
77:     def neg_loglik(params):
78:         mu, cv, cs = params
79:         if cv <= 0 or abs(cs) > 10:
80:             return 1e10
81:         sigma = abs(mu) * cv
82:         if sigma < 1e-10:
83:             return 1e10
84:         alpha = 4 / (cs ** 2) if cs != 0 else 100
85:         beta = sigma / np.sqrt(alpha) if alpha > 0 else 1
86:         shift = mu - alpha * beta
87: 
88:         try:
89:             ll = np.sum(stats.gamma.logpdf(data - shift, a=alpha, scale=beta))
90:             if np.isnan(ll) or np.isinf(ll):
91:                 return 1e10
92:             return -ll
93:         except (ValueError, FloatingPointError, ZeroDivisionError):
94:             return 1e10
95: 
96:     result = minimize(neg_loglik, x0, method='Nelder-Mead',
97:                       options={'maxiter': max_iter})
98: 
99:     if result.success:
100:         mu, cv, cs = result.x
101:         sigma = abs(mu) * cv
102:         alpha = 4 / (cs ** 2) if cs != 0 else 100
103:         beta = sigma / np.sqrt(alpha) if alpha > 0 else 1
104:         shift = mu - alpha * beta
105: 
106:         try:
107:             loglik = np.sum(stats.gamma.logpdf(data - shift, a=alpha, scale=beta))
108:         except (ValueError, FloatingPointError):
109:             loglik = -result.fun
110: 
111:         k = 3
112:         aic = 2 * k - 2 * loglik
113:         bic = k * np.log(n) - 2 * loglik
114: 
115:         return {
116:             'mean': round(float(mu), 4),
117:             'cv': round(float(cv), 4),
118:             'cs': round(float(cs), 4),
119:             'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
120:             'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
121:             'bic': round(float(bic), 2),
122:             'success': True,
123:         }
124:     else:
125:         mean = float(np.mean(data))
126:         cv = float(np.std(data, ddof=1) / mean) if mean != 0 else 0
127:         return {
128:             'mean': mean,
129:             'cv': cv,
130:             'cs': 0,
131:             'loglik': -np.inf,
132:             'aic': np.inf,
133:             'bic': np.inf,
134:             'success': False,
135:         }
136:

138: def lmom_pearson3(
139:     data: np.ndarray,
140: ) -> Dict:
141:     """
142:     ╨Ю╤Ж╨╡╨╜╨║╨░ ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╛╨▓ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨░╨╝╨╕ (probability weighted moments).
143: 
144:     ╬╗1 = mean
145:     ╬╗2 = (mean - Q_med) / 2  (╨┤╨╗╤П ╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛)
146:     ╧Д3 = ╬╗3 / ╬╗2 (╨║╨╛╤Н╤Д╤Д╨╕╤Ж╨╕╨╡╨╜╤В ╨░╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╨╕ L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╛╨▓)
147: 
148:     Parameters:
149:         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
150: 
151:     Returns:
152:         Dict: mean, cv, cs, lambda2, tau3, L-moments
153:     """
154:     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
155:     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
156:     data_sorted = np.sort(data)
157:     n = len(data)
158: 
159:     if n < 5:
160:         return {'mean': float(np.mean(data)), 'cv': 0, 'cs': 0,
161:                 'lambda1': float(np.mean(data)), 'lambda2': 0, 'tau3': 0}
162: 
163:     w = weibull_plotting_position(n)
164: 
165:     # PWM (Probability Weighted Moments)
166:     b0 = np.mean(data_sorted)
167:     b1 = np.mean((1 - w) * data_sorted)
168:     b2 = np.mean((1 - w) ** 2 * data_sorted)
169: 
170:     # L-moments
171:     l1 = b0
172:     l2 = 2 * b1 - b0
173:     l3 = 6 * b2 - 6 * b1 + b0
174: 
175:     tau3 = l3 / l2 if abs(l2) > 1e-10 else 0
176: 
177:     mean = l1
178:     cv = l2 / l1 if l1 != 0 else 0
179: 
180:     # ╨Я╤А╨╕╨▒╨╗╨╕╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ cs ╨╕╨╖ tau3
181:     # ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III: Cs тЙИ tau3 / Cv (╨┐╨╛хЕ│ч│╗ч│╗╨╡ L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╛╨▓, Bobee & Robitaille 1977)
182:     cs = tau3 / cv if abs(cv) > 1e-10 else 0
183: 
184:     return {
185:         'mean': round(float(mean), 4),
186:         'cv': round(float(cv), 4),
187:         'cs': round(float(cs), 4),
188:         'lambda1': round(float(l1), 4),
189:         'lambda2': round(float(l2), 4),
190:         'tau3': round(float(tau3), 4),
191:     }
192:

194: def fit_logpearson3(
195:     data: np.ndarray,
196: ) -> Dict:
197:     """
198:     ╨Ы╨╛╨│╨╜╨╛╤А╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III (Log-Pearson III).
199: 
200:     ╨и╨╕╤А╨╛╨║╨╛ ╨╕╤Б╨┐╨╛╨╗╤М╨╖╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╤Е ╨╛╤Б╨░╨┤╨║╨╛╨▓ ╨╕ ╨┐╨░╨▓╨╛╨┤╨║╨╛╨▓ (╨б╨и╨Р, WMO).
201: 
202:     Parameters:
203:         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
204: 
205:     Returns:
206:         Dict: mean_log, cv_log, cs_log, back-transformed mean/cv
207:     """
208:     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
209:     data = data[data > 0]
210: 
211:     log_data = np.log(data)
212: 
213:     mle = mle_pearson3(log_data)
214: 
215:     return {
216:         'mean_log': mle['mean'],
217:         'cv_log': mle['cv'],
218:         'cs_log': mle['cs'],
219:         'mean_original': round(float(np.exp(mle['mean'] + 0.5 * (mle['cv'] * mle['mean']) ** 2)), 3),
220:         'cv_original': round(float(np.sqrt(np.exp((mle['cv'] * mle['mean']) ** 2) - 1)), 4),
221:         'n': len(data),
222:     }

225: def fit_gev(
226:     data: np.ndarray,
227: ) -> Dict:
228:     """
229:     ╨Ю╨▒╨╛╨▒╤Й╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ (GEV) тАФ GenExtremum.
230: 
231:     F(x) = exp{-(1 + ╬╛(x-╬╝)/╧Г)^(-1/╬╛)}
232: 
233:     Parameters:
234:         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
235: 
236:     Returns:
237:         Dict: shape (╬╛), location (╬╝), scale (╧Г), aic, bic
238:     """
239:     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
240:     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
241: 
242:     if len(data) < 10:
243:         return {'shape': 0, 'location': float(np.mean(data)),
244:                 'scale': float(np.std(data)), 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf}
245: 
246:     try:
247:         shape, loc, scale = stats.genextreme.fit(data)
248: 
249:         n = len(data)
250:         loglik = np.sum(stats.genextreme.logpdf(data, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale))
251:         aic = 2 * 3 - 2 * loglik
252:         bic = 3 * np.log(n) - 2 * loglik
253: 
254:         return {
255:             'shape_xi': round(float(-shape), 4),
256:             'location_mu': round(float(loc), 4),
257:             'scale_sigma': round(float(scale), 4),
258:             'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
259:             'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
260:             'bic': round(float(bic), 2),
261:             'n': n,
262:         }
263:     except Exception:
264:         return {'shape_xi': 0, 'location': float(np.mean(data)),
265:                 'scale': float(np.std(data)), 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf}
266:

268: def fit_weibull3(
269:     data: np.ndarray,
270: ) -> Dict:
271:     """
272:     ╨а╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Т╨╡╨╣╨▒╤Г╨╗╨╗╨░ 3-╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨░.
273: 
274:     F(x) = 1 - exp{-(x - ╬╡)/╬▒)^╬▓}
275: 
276:     Parameters:
277:         data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
278: 
279:     Returns:
280:         Dict: shape (╬▓), scale (╬▒), location (╬╡), aic
281:     """
282:     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
283:     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
284: 
285:     if len(data) < 10:
286:         return {'shape': 0, 'scale': 0, 'location': 0, 'aic': np.inf}
287: 
288:     try:
289:         shape, loc, scale = stats.weibull_min.fit(data, floc=0)
290: 
291:         n = len(data)
292:         loglik = np.sum(stats.weibull_min.logpdf(data, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale))
293:         aic = 2 * 3 - 2 * loglik
294: 
295:         return {
296:             'shape_beta': round(float(shape), 4),
297:             'scale_alpha': round(float(scale), 4),
298:             'location_epsilon': round(float(loc), 4),
299:             'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
300:             'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
301:             'n': n,
302:         }
303:     except Exception:
304:         return {'shape_beta': 0, 'scale_alpha': 0, 'location_epsilon': 0, 'aic': np.inf}

307: def peaks_over_threshold(
308:     data: np.ndarray,
309:     threshold_percentile: float = 95.0,
310:     min_separation_days: int = 5,
311: ) -> Dict:
312:     """
313:     ╨Я╨╛╤А╨╛╨│╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ ╨┐╨╕╨║╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ series (PDS / Peaks Over Threshold).
314: 
315:     ╨б╨Я 33 ╨┐╨╛╨╖╨▓╨╛╨╗╤П╨╡╤В ╨╛╨▒╨░ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤╨░: AMS (╨│╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝╤Л) ╨╕ PDS.
316: 
317:     Parameters:
318:         data: ╤Б╤Г╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╤Л (╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╨╜╤М)
319:         threshold_percentile: ╨┐╤А╨╛╤Ж╨╡╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╤М ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╨╛╤А╨╛╨│╨░ (╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╨╝╨╛╨╗╤З╨░╨╜╨╕╤О 95%)
320:         min_separation_days: ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨▓╨░╨╗ ╨╝╨╡╨╢╨┤╤Г ╨┐╨╕╨║╨░╨╝╨╕, ╤Б╤Г╤В╨║╨╕
321: 
322:     Returns:
323:         Dict: threshold, peaks, n_peaks, annual_rate
324:     """
325:     data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
326:     data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
327: 
328:     threshold = np.percentile(data, threshold_percentile)
329: 
330:     peaks = []
331:     i = 0
332:     while i < len(data):
333:         if data[i] >= threshold:
334:             peak_val = data[i]
335:             peak_idx = i
336:             i += 1
337:             while i < len(data) and data[i] >= threshold:
338:                 if data[i] > peak_val:
339:                     peak_val = data[i]
340:                     peak_idx = i
341:                 i += 1
342:             peaks.append({
343:                 'index': int(peak_idx),
344:                 'value': float(peak_val),
345:             })
346:             i += min_separation_days
347:         else:
348:             i += 1
349: 
350:     n_days = len(data)
351:     n_years = n_days / 365.25
352:     annual_rate = len(peaks) / n_years if n_years > 0 else 0
353: 
354:     return {
355:         'threshold': float(threshold),
356:         'threshold_percentile': threshold_percentile,
357:         'peaks': peaks,
358:         'n_peaks': len(peaks),
359:         'annual_rate': round(float(annual_rate), 2),
360:         'peak_values': [p['value'] for p in peaks],
361:     }
362:

364: def goodness_of_fit(
365:     data: np.ndarray,
366:     distribution: str = 'pearson3',
367:     params: Optional[Dict] = None,

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
        max_iter: ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╨╛ ╨╕╤В╨╡╤А╨░╤Ж╨╕╨╣ ╨╛╨┐╤В╨╕╨╝╨╕╨╖╨░╤Ж╨╕╨╕

    Returns:
        Dict: mean, cv, cs, loglik, aic, bic, success
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
    n = len(data)

    if n < 5:
        return {'mean': float(np.mean(data)), 'cv': 0, 'cs': 0,
                'loglik': -np.inf, 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf, 'success': False}

    x0 = [float(np.mean(data)), float(np.std(data, ddof=1) / np.mean(data)), 0.0]

    def neg_loglik(params):
        mu, cv, cs = params
        if cv <= 0 or abs(cs) > 10:
            return 1e10
        sigma = abs(mu) * cv
        if sigma < 1e-10:
            return 1e10
        alpha = 4 / (cs ** 2) if cs != 0 else 100
        beta = sigma / np.sqrt(alpha) if alpha > 0 else 1
        shift = mu - alpha * beta

        try:
            ll = np.sum(stats.gamma.logpdf(data - shift, a=alpha, scale=beta))
            if np.isnan(ll) or np.isinf(ll):
                return 1e10
            return -ll
        except (ValueError, FloatingPointError, ZeroDivisionError):
            return 1e10

    result = minimize(neg_loglik, x0, method='Nelder-Mead',
                      options={'maxiter': max_iter})

    if result.success:
        mu, cv, cs = result.x
        sigma = abs(mu) * cv
        alpha = 4 / (cs ** 2) if cs != 0 else 100
        beta = sigma / np.sqrt(alpha) if alpha > 0 else 1
        shift = mu - alpha * beta

        try:
            loglik = np.sum(stats.gamma.logpdf(data - shift, a=alpha, scale=beta))
        except (ValueError, FloatingPointError):
            loglik = -result.fun

        k = 3
        aic = 2 * k - 2 * loglik
        bic = k * np.log(n) - 2 * loglik

        return {
            'mean': round(float(mu), 4),
            'cv': round(float(cv), 4),
            'cs': round(float(cs), 4),
            'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
            'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
            'bic': round(float(bic), 2),
            'success': True,
        }
    else:
        mean = float(np.mean(data))
        cv = float(np.std(data, ddof=1) / mean) if mean != 0 else 0
        return {
            'mean': mean,
            'cv': cv,
            'cs': 0,
            'loglik': -np.inf,
            'aic': np.inf,
            'bic': np.inf,
            'success': False,
        }


def lmom_pearson3(
    data: np.ndarray,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Ю╤Ж╨╡╨╜╨║╨░ ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╛╨▓ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨░╨╝╨╕ (probability weighted moments).

    ╬╗1 = mean
    ╬╗2 = (mean - Q_med) / 2  (╨┤╨╗╤П ╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╜╨╛╨│╨╛)
    ╧Д3 = ╬╗3 / ╬╗2 (╨║╨╛╤Н╤Д╤Д╨╕╤Ж╨╕╨╡╨╜╤В ╨░╤Б╨╕╨╝╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╨╕ L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╛╨▓)

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣

    Returns:
        Dict: mean, cv, cs, lambda2, tau3, L-moments
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
    data_sorted = np.sort(data)
    n = len(data)

    if n < 5:
        return {'mean': float(np.mean(data)), 'cv': 0, 'cs': 0,
                'lambda1': float(np.mean(data)), 'lambda2': 0, 'tau3': 0}

    w = weibull_plotting_position(n)

    # PWM (Probability Weighted Moments)
    b0 = np.mean(data_sorted)
    b1 = np.mean((1 - w) * data_sorted)
    b2 = np.mean((1 - w) ** 2 * data_sorted)

    # L-moments
    l1 = b0
    l2 = 2 * b1 - b0
    l3 = 6 * b2 - 6 * b1 + b0

    tau3 = l3 / l2 if abs(l2) > 1e-10 else 0

    mean = l1
    cv = l2 / l1 if l1 != 0 else 0

    # ╨Я╤А╨╕╨▒╨╗╨╕╨╢╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ cs ╨╕╨╖ tau3
    # ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III: Cs тЙИ tau3 / Cv (╨┐╨╛хЕ│ч│╗ч│╗╨╡ L-╨╝╨╛╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╨╛╨▓, Bobee & Robitaille 1977)
    cs = tau3 / cv if abs(cv) > 1e-10 else 0

    return {
        'mean': round(float(mean), 4),
        'cv': round(float(cv), 4),
        'cs': round(float(cs), 4),
        'lambda1': round(float(l1), 4),
        'lambda2': round(float(l2), 4),
        'tau3': round(float(tau3), 4),
    }


def fit_logpearson3(
    data: np.ndarray,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Ы╨╛╨│╨╜╨╛╤А╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III (Log-Pearson III).

    ╨и╨╕╤А╨╛╨║╨╛ ╨╕╤Б╨┐╨╛╨╗╤М╨╖╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╤Е ╨╛╤Б╨░╨┤╨║╨╛╨▓ ╨╕ ╨┐╨░╨▓╨╛╨┤╨║╨╛╨▓ (╨б╨и╨Р, WMO).

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣

    Returns:
        Dict: mean_log, cv_log, cs_log, back-transformed mean/cv
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[data > 0]

    log_data = np.log(data)

    mle = mle_pearson3(log_data)

    return {
        'mean_log': mle['mean'],
        'cv_log': mle['cv'],
        'cs_log': mle['cs'],
        'mean_original': round(float(np.exp(mle['mean'] + 0.5 * (mle['cv'] * mle['mean']) ** 2)), 3),
        'cv_original': round(float(np.sqrt(np.exp((mle['cv'] * mle['mean']) ** 2) - 1)), 4),
        'n': len(data),
    }


def fit_gev(
    data: np.ndarray,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Ю╨▒╨╛╨▒╤Й╤С╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ (GEV) тАФ GenExtremum.

    F(x) = exp{-(1 + ╬╛(x-╬╝)/╧Г)^(-1/╬╛)}

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣

    Returns:
        Dict: shape (╬╛), location (╬╝), scale (╧Г), aic, bic
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]

    if len(data) < 10:
        return {'shape': 0, 'location': float(np.mean(data)),
                'scale': float(np.std(data)), 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf}

    try:
        shape, loc, scale = stats.genextreme.fit(data)

        n = len(data)
        loglik = np.sum(stats.genextreme.logpdf(data, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale))
        aic = 2 * 3 - 2 * loglik
        bic = 3 * np.log(n) - 2 * loglik

        return {
            'shape_xi': round(float(-shape), 4),
            'location_mu': round(float(loc), 4),
            'scale_sigma': round(float(scale), 4),
            'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
            'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
            'bic': round(float(bic), 2),
            'n': n,
        }
    except Exception:
        return {'shape_xi': 0, 'location': float(np.mean(data)),
                'scale': float(np.std(data)), 'aic': np.inf, 'bic': np.inf}


def fit_weibull3(
    data: np.ndarray,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨а╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Т╨╡╨╣╨▒╤Г╨╗╨╗╨░ 3-╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨░.

    F(x) = 1 - exp{-(x - ╬╡)/╬▒)^╬▓}

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣

    Returns:
        Dict: shape (╬▓), scale (╬▒), location (╬╡), aic
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]

    if len(data) < 10:
        return {'shape': 0, 'scale': 0, 'location': 0, 'aic': np.inf}

    try:
        shape, loc, scale = stats.weibull_min.fit(data, floc=0)

        n = len(data)
        loglik = np.sum(stats.weibull_min.logpdf(data, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale))
        aic = 2 * 3 - 2 * loglik

        return {
            'shape_beta': round(float(shape), 4),
            'scale_alpha': round(float(scale), 4),
            'location_epsilon': round(float(loc), 4),
            'loglik': round(float(loglik), 2),
            'aic': round(float(aic), 2),
            'n': n,
        }
    except Exception:
        return {'shape_beta': 0, 'scale_alpha': 0, 'location_epsilon': 0, 'aic': np.inf}


def peaks_over_threshold(
    data: np.ndarray,
    threshold_percentile: float = 95.0,
    min_separation_days: int = 5,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Я╨╛╤А╨╛╨│╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ ╨┐╨╕╨║╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ series (PDS / Peaks Over Threshold).

    ╨б╨Я 33 ╨┐╨╛╨╖╨▓╨╛╨╗╤П╨╡╤В ╨╛╨▒╨░ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤╨░: AMS (╨│╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝╤Л) ╨╕ PDS.

    Parameters:
        data: ╤Б╤Г╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╤Л (╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╤Г╤А╨╛╨▓╨╡╨╜╤М)
        threshold_percentile: ╨┐╤А╨╛╤Ж╨╡╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╤М ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨┐╨╛╤А╨╛╨│╨░ (╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╨╝╨╛╨╗╤З╨░╨╜╨╕╤О 95%)
        min_separation_days: ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨▓╨░╨╗ ╨╝╨╡╨╢╨┤╤Г ╨┐╨╕╨║╨░╨╝╨╕, ╤Б╤Г╤В╨║╨╕

    Returns:
        Dict: threshold, peaks, n_peaks, annual_rate
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]

    threshold = np.percentile(data, threshold_percentile)

    peaks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(data):
        if data[i] >= threshold:
            peak_val = data[i]
            peak_idx = i
            i += 1
            while i < len(data) and data[i] >= threshold:
                if data[i] > peak_val:
                    peak_val = data[i]
                    peak_idx = i
                i += 1
            peaks.append({
                'index': int(peak_idx),
                'value': float(peak_val),
            })
            i += min_separation_days
        else:
            i += 1

    n_days = len(data)
    n_years = n_days / 365.25
    annual_rate = len(peaks) / n_years if n_years > 0 else 0

    return {
        'threshold': float(threshold),
        'threshold_percentile': threshold_percentile,
        'peaks': peaks,
        'n_peaks': len(peaks),
        'annual_rate': round(float(annual_rate), 2),
        'peak_values': [p['value'] for p in peaks],
    }


def goodness_of_fit(
    data: np.ndarray,
    distribution: str = 'pearson3',
    params: Optional[Dict] = None,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤В╨╡╤А╨╕╨╕ ╤Б╨╛╨│╨╗╨░╤Б╨╕╤П ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤Б ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╝╨╕.

    - ╧З┬▓ (╤Е╨╕-╨║╨▓╨░╨┤╤А╨░╤В)
    - K-S (╨Ъ╨╛╨╗╨╝╨╛╨│╨╛╤А╨╛╨▓-╨б╨╝╨╕╤А╨╜╨╛╨▓)
    - A-D (╨Р╨╜╨┤╨╡╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜-╨Ф╨░╤А╨╗╨╕╨╜╨│)

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П
        distribution: 'pearson3', 'normal', 'lognormal', 'gamma', 'gev'
        params: ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╤Л ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П (╨╡╤Б╨╗╨╕ None тАФ ╨┐╨╛╨┤╨▒╨╕╤А╨░╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨╕╨╖ data)

    Returns:
        Dict: ks_stat, ks_p, ad_stat, chi2_stat, chi2_p
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]

    results = {}

    try:
        ks_stat, ks_p = stats.kstest(data, distribution, args=()) if params is None else \
            stats.kstest(data, distribution)
        results['ks_stat'] = round(float(ks_stat), 4)
        results['ks_p'] = round(float(ks_p), 6)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        results['ks_stat'] = 0
        results['ks_p'] = 1

    try:
        ad_stat = stats.anderson(data, dist=distribution if distribution != 'pearson3' else 'norm')
        results['ad_stat'] = round(float(ad_stat.statistic), 4)
        results['ad_critical_values'] = [round(float(x), 3) for x in ad_stat.critical_values]
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        results['ad_stat'] = 0
        results['ad_critical_values'] = []

    n_bins = max(5, int(np.sqrt(len(data))))
    observed, bin_edges = np.histogram(data, bins=n_bins)

    if params is None:
        try:
            if distribution == 'normal':
                mu, sigma = stats.norm.fit(data)
                expected = stats.norm.cdf(bin_edges, mu, sigma)
            elif distribution == 'lognormal':
                shape, loc, scale = stats.lognorm.fit(data, floc=0)
                expected = stats.lognorm.cdf(bin_edges, shape, loc=loc, scale=scale)
            elif distribution == 'gamma':
                a, loc, scale = stats.gamma.fit(data, floc=0)
                expected = stats.gamma.cdf(bin_edges, a, loc=loc, scale=scale)
            else:
                mu, sigma = stats.norm.fit(data)
                expected = stats.norm.cdf(bin_edges, mu, sigma)

            expected_freq = np.diff(expected) * len(data)
            expected_freq = np.maximum(expected_freq, 1)

            chi2_stat = np.sum((observed - expected_freq) ** 2 / expected_freq)
            df = n_bins - 3
            chi2_p = 1 - stats.chi2.cdf(chi2_stat, df) if df > 0 else 1

            results['chi2_stat'] = round(float(chi2_stat), 4)
            results['chi2_p'] = round(float(chi2_p), 6)
        except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
            results['chi2_stat'] = 0
            results['chi2_p'] = 1

    results['n'] = len(data)
    results['distribution'] = distribution

    return results


def qq_plot_data(
    data: np.ndarray,
    distribution: str = 'norm',
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Ф╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨┤╨╗╤П Q-Q ╨│╤А╨░╤Д╨╕╨║╨░ (╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╤М-╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╤М).

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П
        distribution: 'norm', 'lognorm', 'gamma', 'genextreme'

    Returns:
        Dict: theoretical, empirical, theoretical_quantiles, empirical_quantiles
    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    data = np.sort(data[~np.isnan(data)])
    n = len(data)

    p = weibull_plotting_position(n)

    if distribution == 'norm':
        mu, sigma = stats.norm.fit(data)
        theoretical = stats.norm.ppf(p, mu, sigma)
    elif distribution == 'lognorm':
        s, loc, scale = stats.lognorm.fit(data, floc=0)
        theoretical = stats.lognorm.ppf(p, s, loc=loc, scale=scale)
    elif distribution == 'gamma':
        a, loc, scale = stats.gamma.fit(data, floc=0)
        theoretical = stats.gamma.ppf(p, a, loc=loc, scale=scale)
    elif distribution == 'genextreme':
        c, loc, scale = stats.genextreme.fit(data)
        theoretical = stats.genextreme.ppf(p, c, loc=loc, scale=scale)
    else:
        theoretical = stats.norm.ppf(p, *stats.norm.fit(data))

    return {
        'theoretical': theoretical.tolist(),
        'empirical': data.tolist(),
        'n': n,
        'distribution': distribution,
    }


def pp_plot_data(

    """
    ╨Ф╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨┤╨╗╤П P-P ╨│╤А╨░╤Д╨╕╨║╨░ (╨▓╨╡╤А╨╛╤П╤В╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М-╨▓╨╡╤А╨╛╤П╤В╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М).

        data: ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П

    """
    data = np.array(data, dtype=float)

    p_empirical = weibull_plotting_position(n)

    if distribution == 'norm':

def compare_distributions(
    data: np.ndarray,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    ╨б╤А╨░╨▓╨╜╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨╜╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╗╤М╨║╨╕╤Е ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣ ╨┐╨╛ AIC/BIC.

    Parameters:
        data: ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П

    Returns:
        DataFrame ╤Б ╤А╨╡╨╖╤Г╨╗╤М╤В╨░╤В╨░╨╝╨╕
    """
    results = []

    mle_p3 = mle_pearson3(data)

       ╬▒ = 4/Cs┬▓,  ╬▓ = X╠Д┬╖Cv┬╖Cs/2,  AтВА = X╠Д┬╖(1 - 2Cv/Cs)
       X_p = AтВА + Gamma(╬▒, ╬▓)

    ╨б╨╛╨▓╨┐╨░╨┤╨░╨╡╤В ╤Б ╤Н╤В╨░╨╗╨╛╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨│╤А╨░╨╝╨╝╨╛╨╣ HydroStatCalc (╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤Ж╤Л KritkMenc.bin)
    ╨▓ ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨░╤Е ╨┐╨╛╨│╤А╨╡╤И╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤Ж. ╨Ю╤В╤А╨╕╤Ж╨░╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╨╛╨▒╤А╨╡╨╖╨░╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨┤╨╛ ╨╜╤Г╨╗╤П.
    """
    probabilities = np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=float)
    cv = max(abs(cv), 0.001)
    cs = float(cs)
    if abs(cs) < 0.001:
        cs = 0.001

    # --- ╨в╤А╤С╤Е╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╡ ╨│╨░╨╝╨╝╨░-╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ---
    alpha = 4.0 / (cs ** 2)                          # ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Л
    beta = mean * cv * abs(cs) / 2.0                  # ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А ╨╝╨░╤Б╤И╤В╨░╨▒╨░
    A0 = mean * (1.0 - 2.0 * cv / cs)               # ╨╜╨░╤З╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨░╤П ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨░ (╤Б╨┤╨▓╨╕╨│)

    try:
        quantiles = A0 + stats.gamma.ppf(1 - probabilities, a=alpha, scale=beta)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError):
        # Fallback ╨╜╨░ ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╤Г ╨Ъ╨╛╤А╨╜╨╕╤И╨░-╨д╨╕╤И╨╡╤А╨░
        quantiles = pearson3_ppf(probabilities, mean, cv, cs)

    return np.maximum(quantiles, 0.0)


def fit_theoretical_distributions(Q: np.ndarray, p_prob: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    """
    ╨Я╨╛╨┤╨│╨╛╨╜╤П╨╡╤В ╨╜╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╗╤М╨║╨╛ ╤В╨╡╨╛╤А╨╡╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╤Е ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣ ╨║ ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╝.

    Parameters:
        Q: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╤А╨░╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╛╨▓
        p_prob: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓ ╨▓╨╡╤А╨╛╤П╤В╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╡╨╣ (0тАУ1) ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╡╨╣

    Returns:
        dict: {╨╜╨░╨╖╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╨╡: ╨╝╨░╤Б╤Б╨╕╨▓_╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╡╨╣ ╨╕╨╗╨╕ None}
    """
    probabilities = np.asarray(p_prob, dtype=float)

    # Pearson III (╤Б╨║╤М╤О-╨╜╨╛╤А╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡)
    try:
        params = stats.pearson3.fit(Q)
        p3 = stats.pearson3.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        p3 = None

    # Gamma
    try:
        params = stats.gamma.fit(Q, floc=0)
        g = stats.gamma.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        g = None

    # Lognormal
    try:
        params = stats.lognorm.fit(Q, floc=0)
        ln = stats.lognorm.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        ln = None

    # Normal
    try:
        params = stats.norm.fit(Q)
        n = stats.norm.ppf(1 - probabilities, *params)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        n = None

    return {
        "pearson3": p3,
        "gamma": g,
        "lognormal": ln,
        "normal": n
    }


def calculate_frequency_curve(
    data: np.ndarray,
    probabilities: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
    curve_type: CurveType = "pearson3",
    use_corrected: bool = True
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    ╨Я╨╛╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╤А╨░╨╖╨╜╤Л╤Е ╤В╨╕╨┐╨╛╨▓.
    """
    if probabilities is None:
        probabilities = np.array([0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99])

    from core.stats.parameters import calculate_statistical_parameters
    params = calculate_statistical_parameters(data)

    mean = params['mean']
    cv = params['corrected_cv'] if use_corrected else params['cv']
    cs = params['corrected_cs'] if use_corrected else params['cs']

    if curve_type == "normal":
        std = params['std']
        quantiles = stats.norm.ppf(1 - probabilities, loc=mean, scale=std)

    elif curve_type == "pearson3":
        # ╨а╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜╨░ III ╤В╨╕╨┐╨░ тАФ ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╨░ ╨Ъ╨╛╤А╨╜╨╕╤И╨░-╨д╨╕╤И╨╡╤А╨░
        quantiles = pearson3_ppf(probabilities, mean, cv, cs)

    elif curve_type == "kritsky_menkel":
        # ╨а╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡ ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤Ж╨║╨╛╨│╨╛-╨Ь╨╡╨╜╨║╨╡╨╗╤П тАФ ╤В╨░╨▒╨╗╨╕╤З╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ / ╤В╤А╤С╤Е╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╡ ╨│╨░╨╝╨╝╨░
        quantiles = kritsky_menkel_ppf(probabilities, mean, cv, cs)

    elif curve_type == "empirical":
        # ╨а╤П╨┤ ╤Б╨╛╤А╤В╨╕╤А╤Г╨╡╤В╤Б╤П ╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╨▒╤Л╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╤О: m=1 тАФ ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╤З╨╗╨╡╨╜ ╤А╤П╨┤╨░,
        # ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨░╤П ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М P_m = (m - 0.3)/(n + 0.4).
        q_desc = np.sort(data)[::-1]
        n = len(q_desc)
        emp_probs = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
        quantiles = np.interp(probabilities, emp_probs, q_desc,
                              left=q_desc[0], right=q_desc[-1])

    elif curve_type == "piecewise":
        # ╨Ш╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨┐╨╛╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╤П ╨╗╨╛╨╝╨░╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╡╨╣ (╨У╨У╨Ш):
        # ╨в╨╛╤З╨║╨╕ ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╛╨╣ ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╨╛╤Б╨╗╨╡╨┤╨╛╨▓╨░╤В╨╡╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛ ╤Б╨╛╨╡╨┤╨╕╨╜╤П╤О╤В╤Б╤П ╨╛╤В╤А╨╡╨╖╨║╨░╨╝╨╕
        # ╨┐╤А╤П╨╝╤Л╤Е. ╨а╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ тАФ ╨┐╨╛ ╨║╨╛╨╛╤А╨┤╨╕╨╜╨░╤В╨░╨╝ ╤Н╤В╨╕╤Е ╨╛╤В╤А╨╡╨╖╨║╨╛╨▓.
        q_desc = np.sort(data)[::-1]
        n = len(q_desc)
        emp_probs = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
        # ╨Ы╨╕╨╜╨╡╨╣╨╜╨░╤П ╨╕╨╜╤В╨╡╤А╨┐╨╛╨╗╤П╤Ж╨╕╤П ╨╝╨╡╨╢╨┤╤Г ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╝╨╕ ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨░╨╝╨╕
        quantiles = np.interp(probabilities, emp_probs, q_desc,
                              left=q_desc[0], right=q_desc[-1])

    elif curve_type == "none":
        quantiles = np.full_like(probabilities, np.nan)
    else:
        std = params['std']
        quantiles = stats.norm.ppf(1 - probabilities, loc=mean, scale=std)

    return pd.DataFrame({
        'P_%': np.round(probabilities * 100, 2),
        'Q': np.round(quantiles, 2)
    })


# ============================================================
# ╨Я╨Ю╨Ф╨С╨Ю╨а Cs/Cv ╨Р╨Т╨в╨Ю╨Ь╨Р╨в╨Ю╨Ь (╨У╨У╨Ш: ┬л╨Я╨╛╨┤╨▒╨╛╤А Cs/Cv┬╗)
# ============================================================
#
# ╨Ь╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨╕╨╖╨░╤Ж╨╕╤П╬г(Y╤Н╨╝╨┐.i - Y╤В╨╡╨╛╤А.i)┬▓ ╨┐╨╛ Cs/Cv
# ╤Б ╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤М╤О ╨┤╨╛ 0.05 (╨║╨░╨║ ╨▓ ╨╛╤А╨╕╨│╨╕╨╜╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨│╤А╨░╨╝╨╝╨╡ ╨У╨У╨Ш)
#
# ╨Ф╨╕╨░╨┐╨░╨╖╨╛╨╜ P: ┬л╨▓╨╡╤Б╤М┬╗ ╨╕╨╗╨╕ ┬л╤Г╨║╨░╨╖╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣┬╗ (P% > ╨╕ P% <)


def auto_select_cs_cv(
    data: np.ndarray,
    curve_type: str = 'pearson3',
    p_range: Optional[tuple] = None,
    precision: float = 0.05,
    cs_cv_min: float = -2.0,
    cs_cv_max: float = 6.0,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨Р╨▓╤В╨╛╨╝╨░╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╣ ╨┐╨╛╨┤╨▒╨╛╤А ╨╛╤В╨╜╨╛╤И╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П Cs/Cv ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╨╛╨╣ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕.

    ╨Р╨╗╨│╨╛╤А╨╕╤В╨╝ (╨У╨У╨Ш):
    1. ╨Т╤Л╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╨╕╤В╤М ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╡ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ ╨┐╨╛ ╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╨╡ ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤Ж╨║╨╛╨│╨╛-╨Ь╨╡╨╜╨║╨╡╨╗╤П
       P = (m - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
    2. ╨Я╨╡╤А╨╡╨▒╤А╨░╤В╤М Cs/Cv ╨╛╤В cs_cv_min ╨┤╨╛ cs_cv_max ╤Б ╤И╨░╨│╨╛╨╝ precision
    3. ╨Ф╨╗╤П ╨║╨░╨╢╨┤╨╛╨│╨╛ Cs/Cv: ╨┐╨╛╤Б╤В╤А╨╛╨╕╤В╤М ╤В╨╡╨╛╤А╨╡╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╤Г╤О ╨║╤А╨╕╨▓╤Г╤О (╨Я╨╕╤А╤Б╨╛╨╜ III ╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╨Ъ-╨Ь)
    4. ╨Т╤Л╤З╨╕╤Б╨╗╨╕╤В╤М╬г(Y╤Н╨╝╨┐ - Y╤В╨╡╨╛╤А)┬▓ ╨┐╨╛ ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨░╨╝ ╨▓ ╨╖╨░╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╨╛╨╝ ╨┤╨╕╨░╨┐╨░╨╖╨╛╨╜╨╡ P
    5. ╨Т╤Л╨▒╤А╨░╤В╤М Cs/Cv ╤Б ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤Б╤Г╨╝╨╝╨╛╨╣

    ╨Р╤А╨│╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╤Л:
        data тАФ ╨╕╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╡
        curve_type тАФ 'pearson3' ╨╕╨╗╨╕ 'kritsky_menkel'
        p_range тАФ (P_min, P_max) ╨▓ ╨┤╨╛╨╗╤П╤Е (0-1), None = ╨▓╨╡╤Б╤М ╨┤╨╕╨░╨┐╨░╨╖╨╛╨╜
        precision тАФ ╤И╨░╨│ ╨┐╨╡╤А╨╡╨▒╨╛╤А╨░ Cs/Cv (default 0.05)
        cs_cv_min тАФ ╨╜╨╕╨╢╨╜╤П╤П ╨│╤А╨░╨╜╨╕╤Ж╨░ Cs/Cv
        cs_cv_max тАФ ╨▓╨╡╤А╤Е╨╜╤П╤П ╨│╤А╨░╨╜╨╕╤Ж╨░ Cs/Cv

    ╨Т╨╛╨╖╨▓╤А╨░╤Й╨░╨╡╤В dict:
        cs_cv_optimal тАФ ╨╛╨┐╤В╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╡ Cs/Cv
        ss_min тАФ ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨░╤П ╤Б╤Г╨╝╨╝╨░ ╨║╨▓╨░╨┤╤А╨░╤В╨╛╨▓
        all_results тАФ ╤Б╨┐╨╕╤Б╨╛╨║ {cs_cv, ss} ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨▓╤Б╨╡╤Е ╨┐╨╡╤А╨╡╨▒╤А╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╤Е ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╣
        quantiles тАФ ╤В╨╡╨╛╤А╨╡╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╡ ╨║╨▓╨░╨╜╤В╨╕╨╗╨╕ ╨┐╤А╨╕ ╨╛╨┐╤В╨╕╨╝╨░╨╗╤М╨╜╨╛╨╝ Cs/Cv
        empirical тАФ ╤Н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╡ ╤В╨╛╤З╨║╨╕
        cv тАФ Cv ╨╕╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╜╤Л╤Е ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╤Е
    """
    data = np.asarray(data, dtype=float)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]
    n = len(data)

    if n < 5:
        return {
            'cs_cv_optimal': None,
            'ss_min': float('inf'),
            'message': f'╨Э╨╡╨┤╨╛╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛ ╨┤╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╤Е (n={n} < 5)',
        }

    # ╨С╨░╨╖╨╛╨▓╤Л╨╡ ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╤Л
    mean_val = np.mean(data)
    cv = np.std(data, ddof=1) / mean_val if mean_val > 0 else 0

    # ╨н╨╝╨┐╨╕╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╡ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕ (╤Д╨╛╤А╨╝╤Г╨╗╨░ ╨Ъ╤А╨╕╤Ж╨║╨╛╨│╨╛-╨Ь╨╡╨╜╨║╨╡╨╗╤П)
    sorted_data = np.sort(data)[::-1]  # ╨┐╨╛ ╤Г╨▒╤Л╨▓╨░╨╜╨╕╤О
    emp_probs = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.3) / (n + 0.4)
    emp_quantiles = sorted_data

    # ╨б╤В╨░╨╜╨┤╨░╤А╤В╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╨╕╨╕
    std_probs = np.array([0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5,
                          0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.97, 0.99, 0.999])
    std_probs_pct = std_probs * 100

    # ╨д╨╕╨╗╤М╤В╤А╨░╤Ж╨╕╤П ╨┐╨╛ ╨┤╨╕╨░╨┐╨░╨╖╨╛╨╜╤Г P
    if p_range is not None:
        p_min, p_max = p_range
        mask = (emp_probs >= p_min) & (emp_probs <= p_max)
        eval_probs = emp_probs[mask]
        eval_emp = emp_quantiles[mask]
    else:
        eval_probs = emp_probs
        eval_emp = emp_quantiles

    if len(eval_probs) < 3:
        return {
            'cs_cv_optimal': None,
            'ss_min': float('inf'),

class HistoricalExtreme:
    """╨Ш╤Б╤В╨╛╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╨╣ ╤Н╨║╤Б╤В╤А╨╡╨╝╤Г╨╝ (╨│╨╛╨┤, ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡, ╨┐╨╡╤А╨╕╨╛╨┤)."""

    def __init__(self, year: int, value: float, period: int):
        self.year = year
        self.value = value
        self.period = period
        self.exceedance_prob = 1.0 / (period + 0.5)

def compute_params_with_extremes(
    data: np.ndarray,
    extremes: list,
    is_max: bool = True,
) -> Dict:
    """
    ╨а╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╨╛╨▓ ╤А╨░╤Б╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╨╡╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤Б ╤Г╤З╤С╤В╨╛╨╝ ╨╕╤Б╤В╨╛╤А╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕╤Е ╤Н╨║╤Б╤В╤А╨╡╨╝╤Г╨╝╨╛╨▓.

    2. ╨Ф╨╛╨▒╨░╨▓╨╕╤В╤М ╤Н╨║╤Б╤В╤А╨╡╨╝╤Г╨╝ ╨║ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨░╨╡╨╝╨╛╨╝╤Г ╤А╤П╨┤╤Г ╤Б ╨▓╨╡╤Б╨╛╨╝ 1/(N+1)
    3. ╨Я╨╡╤А╨╡╤Б╤З╨╕╤В╨░╤В╤М ╤Б╤А╨╡╨┤╨╜╨╡╨╡ ╨╕ Cv ╤Б ╤Г╤З╤С╤В╨╛╨╝ ╤Н╨║╤Б╤В╤А╨╡╨╝╤Г╨╝╨╛╨▓

    ╨Р╤А╨│╤Г╨╝╨╡╨╜╤В╤Л:
        data тАФ ╨╜╨░╨▒╨╗╤О╨┤╨░╨╡╨╝╤Л╨╡ ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П

        is_max тАФ True ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨╝╨░╨║╤Б╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝╨╛╨▓, False ╨┤╨╗╤П ╨╝╨╕╨╜╨╕╨╝╤Г╨╝╨╛╨▓

    ╨Т╨╛╨╖╨▓╤А╨░╤Й╨░╨╡╤В dict:
        mean_raw, cv_raw тАФ ╨╕╤Б╤Е╨╛╨┤╨╜╤Л╨╡ ╨┐╨░╤А╨░╨╝╨╡╤В╤А╤Л
        mean_corrected, cv_corrected тАФ ╤Б╨║╨╛╤А╤А╨╡╨║╤В╨╕╤А╨╛╨▓╨░╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╡
        corrections тАФ ╨┐╨╛╨┐╤А╨░╨▓╨║╨╕
        extremes_with_probs тАФ ╤Н╨║╤Б╤В╤А╨╡╨╝╤Г╨╝╤Л ╤Б ╨╛╨▒╨╡╤Б╨┐╨╡╤З╨╡╨╜╨╜╨╛╤Б╤В╤П╨╝╨╕

    data = data[~np.isnan(data)]

            'cv_raw': 0,

            'cv_corrected': 0,

    if not extremes:

            'cv_raw': round(cv_raw, 4),

    mean_corrected = mean_raw + delta_mean

    # ╨Я╨╛╨┐╤А╨░╨▓╨║╨░ ╨║ Cv:

    delta_cv = 0
    for ext in extremes:

    cv_corrected = np.sqrt(cv_raw ** 2 + delta_cv) if cv_raw > 0 else np.sqrt(delta_cv)

        'cv_raw': round(cv_raw, 4),

        'cv_corrected': round(cv_corrected, 4),

63: 
64:     ╨б╨Я 33-101-2003 ╨┐. 6.2.3: ╤Б╨▓╤П╨╖╤М ╨┐╤А╨╕╨╖╨╜╨░╤С╤В╤Б╤П ╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨╛╨╣ ╨┐╤А╨╕ R > Ro(╬▒, n).
65: 
66:     Parameters:

70:

73:     """

92:     if R > 0.95:

114: def regression_extension(
115:     Q_calc: pd.Series,
116:     Q_analog: pd.Series
117: ) -> Dict:
118:     """
119:     ╨а╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╛╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣ ╨╝╨╡╤В╨╛╨┤ ╨┐╤А╨╛╨┤╨╗╨╡╨╜╨╕╤П ╤А╤П╨┤╨░.
120: 
121:     Q╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В = a ├Ч Q╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│ + b
122: 
123:     Parameters:
124:         Q_calc: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨░╤Б╤З╤С╤В╨╜╨╛╨╣ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕ (╨║╨╛╤А╨╛╤В╨║╨╕╨╣)
125:         Q_analog: ╤А╤П╨┤ ╤А╨╡╨║╨╕-╨░╨╜╨░╨╗╨╛╨│╨░ (╨┤╨╗╨╕╨╜╨╜╤Л╨╣)
126: 
127:     Returns:
128:         Dict: a, b, R, n_common, validation, extended_series
129:     """
130:     validation = validate_correlation(Q_calc, Q_analog)
131:     if not validation['is_significant']:
132:         pass  # ╨┐╤А╨╡╨┤╤Г╨┐╤А╨╡╨╢╨┤╨░╨╡╨╝, ╨╜╨╛ ╨╜╨╡ ╨▒╨╗╨╛╨║╨╕╤А╤Г╨╡╨╝
133: 
134:     common_idx = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
135:     if len(common_idx) < 2:
136:         raise ValueError("╨Э╨╡╨┤╨╛╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╛╤З╨╜╨╛ ╨╛╨▒╤Й╨╕╤Е ╨╗╨╡╤В ╨┤╨╗╤П ╤А╨╡╨│╤А╨╡╤Б╤Б╨╕╨╕ (╨╜╤Г╨╢╨╜╨╛ тЙе 2)")
137: 
138:     Qc = Q_calc.loc[common_idx]
139:     Qa = Q_analog.loc[common_idx]
140:     result = stats.linregress(Qa.values, Qc.values)
141:     a = float(result.slope)
142:     b = float(result.intercept)
143: 
144:     Q_ext = Q_analog.copy().astype(float)
145: 
146:     missing = Q_analog.index.difference(Q_calc.index)
147:     if len(missing) > 0:
148:         Q_ext.loc[missing] = a * Q_analog.loc[missing] + b
149: 
150:     common = Q_calc.index.intersection(Q_analog.index)
151:     Q_ext.loc[common] = Q_calc.loc[common]
152: 
153:     return {
154:         'a': round(a, 6),
155:         'b': round(b, 4),
156:         'R': validation['R'],
157:         'R2': validation['R2'],
158:         'Ro_crit': validation['Ro_crit'],
159:         'n_common': validation['n_common'],
160:         'is_significant': validation['is_significant'],
161:         'quality_class': validation['quality_class'],
162:         'extended_series': Q_ext,
163:         'warning': None if validation['is_significant'] else
164:                    f"R={validation['R']:.3f} < Ro={validation['Ro_crit']:.3f}. ╨б╨▓╤П╨╖╤М ╤Б╤В╨░╤В╨╕╤Б╤В╨╕╤З╨╡╤Б╨║╨╕ ╨╜╨╡╨╖╨╜╨░╤З╨╕╨╝╨░!"
165:     }
